description_en: Turkish oya needle lace: three-dimensional knotted floral picots, clove and carnation edges in relief, airy motif gaps, not Chantilly mesh, not Ñandutí sun-wheels, not tatting, not Alençon.
description_zh: 奥亚花边：土耳其立体针结小花与珠边，丁香康乃馨浮雕，留空底，非尚蒂伊网眼、非南杜蒂日轮、非梭结、非阿朗松。

description_en: Levi Hill early color daguerreotype: muddy prismatic stains on a specular silver plate, unstable reds and cyan, tarnish bloom, not Autochrome grains, not Lippmann interference, not monochrome daguerreotype.
description_zh: 希洛彩版：利维·希尔早期彩色银版，泥彩棱斑贴于镜面银板，红青不稳与氧化晕，非奥托克罗姆颗粒、非李普曼干涉、非单色达盖尔。

description_en: Medieval silver-stain on glass: silver compounds fired to lemon-honey transillumination with black vitreous trace, not jewel-tone leaded mosaic, not verre églomisé gold leaf, not enamel grisaille alone.
description_zh: 银染黄釉：银盐烧入白玻璃成柠檬黄至蜜琥珀色透光，配黑釉描线，非宝石色铅条镶嵌、非反绘金箔、非单纯珐琅灰色。

description_en: Japanese hiramaki-e: pictorial sprinkled flat with gold and colored metal powders flush in thin urushi over roiro-black, low-relief polished grain, not raised takamaki-e, not carved tixi, not raden shell.
description_zh: 平莳绘：金粉与彩金属粉平撒于薄漆膜、黑蜡色地上磨平，浅浮颗粒，非高莳绘堆起、非剔犀雕漆、非螺钿。

description_en: Serti gutta-resist silk painting: closed gutta cells flooded with jewel-tone silk dyes and capillary wick on habotai sheen, not batik wax crackle, not yuzen rice-paste, not watercolor paper.
description_zh: 胶线丝绘：胶线封闭色格，丝染料渗染成宝石色晕与纺绸光泽，非蜡染龟裂、非友禅糊防、非纸本水彩。

description_en: Murano corroso: acid-bitten matte orange-peel frost with leftover polished cristallo islands and smoky amethyst-green tint, not battuto facets, not ice-glass crackle, not leaded stained glass.
description_zh: 酸蚀玻璃：酸咬成橘皮哑光霜面，留抛光水晶岛与烟紫绿沁色，非锤纹切面、非冰裂玻璃、非铅条彩窗。

description_en: Blind embossing: inkless intaglio bruise in cotton rag, white-on-white plate-mark revealed only by raking light, not letterpress ink, not trapunto, not plaster relief.
description_zh: 盲压浮雕：无墨凹版压入棉浆纸，仅侧光显出白上白版痕，非有墨凸印、非填充绗缝、非石膏浮雕。

description_en: Alcohol ink on Yupo: high-flow dye cells, isopropyl veining, magenta-teal-gold pools and hard ring stains on synthetic paper, not watercolor granulation, not acrylic pour, not ebru marbling.
description_zh: 酒精墨水：Yupo上高流染料格、异丙醇脉络与品红青绿金环渍，非水彩沉淀、非丙烯倾倒、非水拓。

description_en: Togidashi maki-e: gold and silver powder sprinkled into wet urushi then polished completely flush so metal flakes sit in a glassy lacquer surface, not raised takamaki-e, not slightly proud hiramaki-e, not nashiji pear-skin only.
description_zh: 研出莳绘：金银粉洒入湿漆后通体研磨齐平，金属屑嵌于镜面漆层，非高莳绘浮起、非平莳绘微凸、非梨地单独肌理。

description_en: Barbotine slip-trailing: thick liquid clay piped in high-relief beads, leaves and scrolls on glazed earthenware, wet-slip peaks and glaze pooling in valleys, not oil impasto, not sgraffito, not sculpture in the round.
description_zh: 泥浆堆塑：稠泥浆沥出高浮雕珠点叶卷于釉陶，湿泥峰与凹处积釉，非油画厚涂、非刮刻、非圆雕。

description_en: Alicatado: Andalusian cut-and-fitted glazed ceramic tiles assembled into geometric star-and-interlace patterns with visible snipped edges and grout, not zellige chip mosaic, not painted azulejo.
description_zh: 切割釉砖：安达卢西亚切割釉陶拼成星纹交织，可见剪边与填缝，非泽利格碎嵌、非手绘阿兹勒霍。

description_en: Split fountain printing: lithographic/offset ink duct divided so several colors blend continuously across one roller in a single pass, lateral rainbow banding and ink-kiss paper tooth, not rainbow-roll viscosity, not risograph, not digital gradient.
description_zh: 分槽渐变墨：平版墨槽分隔使多色在同一滚筒一次走纸横向交融，可见辊带与纸齿吻墨，非彩虹辊粘滞套印、非孔版、非数码渐变。

description_en: Flow blue: Victorian underglaze cobalt transfer that bleeds and halos into the glaze on white ironstone, fuzzy running outlines and smoky blue blooms, not crisp transferware, not blue-and-white porcelain, not Delft.
description_zh: 流蓝釉：维多利亚钴线下釉转印在白铁石瓷上晕散成烟蓝与模糊轮廓，非清晰转印、非青花瓷、非代尔夫特。

description_en: Takamaki-e: raised Japanese maki-e lacquer built up with sprinkled gold and colored urushi on a black ground, high-relief metal-powder ridges, not flat hiramaki-e, not togidashi polish.
description_zh: 高莳绘：在黑漆地上堆起金粉与彩漆的高浮雕莳绘，金属粉棱脊受光，非平莳绘、非研出莳绘。

description_en: Pargeting: English ornamental lime-plaster relief with strapwork, tooled ridges and limewash bloom on timber-framed walls, not marble carving, not fresco, not stucco.
description_zh: 灰泥浮雕：英式石灰泥装饰浮雕，卷草与梳纹、粉刷白霜贴在木构墙面，非大理石雕、非湿壁画、非灰泥壁画。

description_en: Song brocade: warp-faced Song-dynasty silk with repeating geometric lozenges, nested octagons and gold weft floats, woven thread pixels, not Yunjin, not kesi, not embroidery.
description_zh: 宋锦：宋代经面织锦，菱格套八边形与金纬浮线、织纹像素可见，非云锦、非缂丝、非刺绣。

description_en: Naked raku: white crackle slip peeled after smoking so carbon veins stain the clay body, dry matte ceramic, not glazed raku, not horsehair raku, not obvara.
description_zh: 裸烧：熏烧后揭去白色裂纹化妆土，碳黑脉络渗入陶体，干哑陶瓷，非釉乐烧、非马毛乐烧、非奥布瓦拉。

description_en: Crible: 15th-century dotted metalcut, punched white dots and star-punches on a black plate with engraved outlines, not mezzotint, not stipple engraving, not woodcut.
description_zh: 点凿铜版：十五世纪白点金属凸刻，黑地上凿白点与星形冲孔、阴刻轮廓，非美柔汀、非点刻铜版、非木刻。

description_en: Tunbridge ware: English tessellated stickware of tiny end-grain wood squares in geometric banded mosaic, not yosegi, not marquetry veneer, not intarsia.
description_zh: 坦布里奇细木：英式端纹小木方几何镶嵌，条带马赛克，非寄木细工、非薄木贴花、非嵌木细工。

description_en: Amanteca: Aztec feather mosaic of iridescent tiny plumage tesserae and overlapping vanes, not Huichol yarn painting, not micromosaic, not stained glass.
description_zh: 羽镶嵌：阿兹特克羽毛马赛克，虹彩细羽鳞片层层交叠，非惠乔尔毛线画、非微型马赛克、非彩窗。

description_en: Verdure: Flemish leafy tapestry with wool-weft hatchure, slit joins and moss-sage foliage filling the field, not millefleur, not Gobelin portrait, not embroidery.
description_zh: 青绿挂毯：佛兰德斯叶丛挂毯，羊毛纬线影线与开口、满地苔绿枝叶，非碎花千花、非戈布兰肖像、非刺绣。

description_en: Nuno felt: wool fibers migrated through gauzy silk, cobweb edges and translucent layered clouds, not needle felt sculpture, not dense wet-felt painting, not embroidery.
description_zh: 湿毡贴织：羊毛纤维渗入薄纱丝绸，蛛网边缘与半透明层云，非针毡雕塑、非厚实湿毡画、非刺绣。

description_en: Paste paper: 18th-century Kleisterpapier of colored starch paste combed, sponged and stamped into fans and waves on laid paper, not ebru, not suminagashi, not block-print wallpaper.
description_zh: 浆糊花纸：十八世纪彩色淀粉浆梳纹、海绵与戳印扇浪铺在布纹纸上，非埃布鲁、非墨流、非木版壁纸。

description_en: Kanshitsu: dry lacquer over hemp-cloth armature, urushi-soaked layers carved and polished to a resin skin with cloth-fiber tooth, not tixi carved layers, not maki-e powder, not wood carving.
description_zh: 夹纻乾漆：麻布胎浸生漆层层堆塑再雕磨成树脂皮、可见布纹齿，非剔犀、非莳绘洒金、非木雕。

description_en: Rayograph: cameraless photogram on silver gelatin, objects and figure laid on paper and lamp-exposed into milky whites and inky blacks, not cyanotype, not Sabattier solarization, not a camera portrait.
description_zh: 雷摄影：银盐相纸实物投影，灯下叠出乳白与浓黑，非蓝晒、非萨巴蒂、非相机肖像。

description_en: Goldwork: padded passing thread, bullion coils, plate and pearl purl couched on dark velvet, metallic stitch glints, not sequin fashion, not chrome 3D, not kintsugi.
description_zh: 金银线绣：垫芯金线、盘金、亮片与珍珠金线钉在深绒上，非亮片时装、非三维铬金、非金缮。

description_en: Japanning: European black asphaltum-and-copal lacquer with raised gilt chinoiserie and vermilion, aged varnish craquelure, not authentic urushi maki-e, not tole painting.
description_zh: 洋漆工艺：欧洲沥青柯巴黑漆、凸起描金与朱红、旧漆开裂，非正宗莳绘、非铁皮彩绘。

description_en: Theorem painting: reverse stencils dusted onto black cotton velvet, pigment sitting in the pile, 19th-century American folk fruit-and-figure, not pochoir print, not oil still life.
description_zh: 模版绒画：反向模版粉扑在黑棉绒上、颜料陷在绒毛里，十九世纪美国民俗果人物，非镂版印刷、非油画静物。

description_en: Stippled watercolor on polished ivory; porcelain skin, oval plaque glow.
description_zh: 象牙底上点染水彩；瓷质肤色、椭圆牌匾光晕。

description_en: Rajasthani mud-resist block print; indigo-madder dyes, cracked reserved motifs.
description_zh: 拉贾斯坦泥浆防染木版印；靛蓝茜红、开裂留白纹样。

description_en: Layered oyster-shell white of Nihonga; chalky luminous whites on washi.
description_zh: 日本画胡粉层层罩白；和纸上的白垩光泽。

description_en: Velvety black chalk on toned laid paper; reserved lights, stumped midtones.
description_zh: 暖色铺纹纸上的丝绒黑石粉笔；留白高光、擦揉中间调。

description_en: Painterly tusche washes printed from stone; granular greys, no engraved line.
description_zh: 油脂墨水在石版上的渲染印制；颗粒灰阶、无雕版硬线。

description_en: Reverse-glass oils over crumpled metallic foil; translucent glazes flash against gold and silver leaf.
description_zh: 玻璃背面薄油彩叠皱箔；透明釉色在金银箔上闪光。

description_en: Japanese gilt embossed leather; tooled arabesques, gold and colored lacquer in the grain.
description_zh: 日本金唐革：浮雕压花皮革，金漆与彩漆填入皮纹。

description_en: Early ukiyo-e with hand-brushed safflower beni on a spare key-block; paper reserves, almost no other color.
description_zh: 早期浮世绘：墨线主版上手涂红花瓣颜料，大面积留白。

description_en: Mid-18th-century English transfer-printed enamel on copper; white ground, puce print, gilt rococo rim.
description_zh: 18世纪中叶英国铜胎珐琅：白地转印、紫红线稿、洛可可描金边。

description_en: Herschel 1842 silver printing-out paper; warm rusty browns, paper fiber, no carbon black.
description_zh: 赫歇尔1842银盐晒印：暖锈棕、纸纹可见、无碳黑。

description_en: Mikawachi milky-white porcelain with hair-fine underglaze cobalt; celadon-tinged glaze pools, faint craquelure.
description_zh: 三川内平户烧：乳白瓷上发丝钴蓝釉下彩，青白积釉与细开片。

description_en: Sculptural vitreous enamel in the round on gold; translucent jewel volumes, gold beads, no flat cloisonné cells.
description_zh: 金胎立体珐琅：三维宝石釉体、金珠金丝，非平面掐丝。

description_en: Additive mosaic screen-plate color: regular RGB filter grid on glass, muted dyes, not Autochrome grains or Dufay réseau.
description_zh: 加法彩屏干版：规则红绿蓝滤网、柔和染料，非奥托铬淀粉粒、非杜菲网线。

description_en: Gold and silver leaf sheets on lacquer size, ink and mineral color over burnished foil; not kirikane tesserae or nashiji powder.
description_zh: 金箔银箔贴于漆胶，箔上墨与矿物色；非切金细片、非梨地洒金。

description_en: Danish whitework: cutwork needlelace, drawn-thread grids, raised buttonhole rings on white linen, no colored thread.
description_zh: 丹麦海泽布白绣：镂空针绣、抽纱网格、凸起锁边圆环，无彩线。

description_en: Kagawa lacquer: incised hairline grooves on black urushi filled with colored lacquer and gold powder.
description_zh: 香川存星漆：黑漆地阴刻细线，填入彩漆与金粉。

description_en: 18th-century gilt brocade paper: woodblock arabesques in gold size on colored laid paper.
description_zh: 十八世纪荷兰金箔纸：色底上木版印金纹卷草。

description_en: Polished lime plaster: thin burnished putty layers with earth pigments fused into a marble sheen.
description_zh: 抛光灰泥：薄层石灰膏抛光，土性颜料融入大理石光泽。

description_en: Historical iron-gall ink on laid paper: brown-black quill hatching with rusty corrosion bloom.
description_zh: 铁胆墨：米色布纹纸上褐黑羽毛笔排线，浓墨处微锈晕。

description_en: Cut-paper construction: nested washi layers, knife-cut silhouettes, paper bridges and cast shadows.
description_zh: 切纸构成：多层和纸刀刻剪影、纸桥与层间投影。

description_en: Pressed-splatter transfer: flicked oil blooms, squeezed ridges, satellite droplets and ghost veils.
description_zh: 泼溅转印：甩滴油彩再对压，绽开色晕、挤脊、卫星飞点与残影。

description_en: Camera-less photogram: contact silhouettes, X-ray translucency, chemical fog on black paper.
description_zh: 沙德光影图：无相机接触曝光，剪影叠影、半透明骨骼感与药雾。

description_en: Papier dominoté: small woodblock repeats, mineral stencil fills, laid-paper grain and slight misregister.
description_zh: 多米诺彩纸：小木版重复纹样、矿物颜料模填、布纹纸与轻微套印偏移。

description_en: Open-bite intaglio: broad acid-eaten planes, foul biting, plate tone and a visible plate mark.
description_zh: 开放咬蚀：大面积酸咬浅调、蚀斑、余墨与清晰版痕。

description_en: Kanoko shibori: dense fawn-spot bind-resist dots, puckered cloth memory, indigo dye bleed at specks.
description_zh: 鹿子絞：细密绑防白点、布面皱记、靛蓝在斑点边缘渗化。

description_en: Aari tambour-hook embroidery: dense chain stitches, zari metal thread, raised floral filling on cloth.
description_zh: 阿利绣：绷钩链式密针、金线扎里、凸起花卉填满布面。

description_en: Ikakeji lacquer: packed gold-powder ground, microscopic kinpun, urushi sheen as a solid glittering field.
description_zh: 沃懸地：密洒金粉地、细粒金粉、漆面光泽连成一片金地。

description_en: Ozotype: pigmented bichromated-gelatin contact print, matte carbon-like tone, velvety pigment grain.
description_zh: 奥佐型：色素重铬酸盐明胶接触印相、无光碳调、绒面颜料颗粒。

description_en: Kasuti counted-thread work: gavanti and murgi stitches, double-sided geometry, folk temple motifs on evenweave.
description_zh: 卡苏蒂绣：计针几何、正反同纹、神庙民俗纹样绣于平纹布。

description_en: Claire-de-lune glaze: pale bluish moon-white porcelain, opalescent pooling, quiet kiln sheen.
description_zh: 月白釉：淡蓝月白瓷釉、乳光积釉、安静窑光。

description_en: Arashi shibori: pole-wrap storm resist, diagonal indigo ladders, crinkled cloth grain.
description_zh: 岚绞：绕杆风暴防染、斜向靛蓝梯纹、布面皱理。

description_en: Yohen tenmoku: oil-black Jian glaze, rainbow halo spots, kiln-pool iridescence.
description_zh: 曜变天目：油黑建盏釉、虹晕油滴、窑池虹彩。

description_en: Gesso sottile: thin Italian chalk ground, luminous gypsum panel, tempera-ready matte.
description_zh: 细石膏底：意式薄石膏地、透亮石膏板、蛋彩哑光底。

description_en: Gilding bolus: red bole clay under burnished gold leaf, worn gaps, agate sheen.
description_zh: 红土金底：红土石膏上贴金箔、磨损露红、玛瑙抛光。

description_en: Chrysography: powdered gold-ink drawing on dark ground, metallic contour, shell-gold wash.
description_zh: 金墨书绘：暗地金粉墨线、金属轮廓、泥金薄染。

description_en: Wakasa-nuri: layered urushi with buried gold, silver, eggshell and nacre, polished through to a speckled cross-section.
description_zh: 若狭塗：多层彩漆埋入金银箔、蛋壳与螺钿，研磨透出斑斓断面。

description_en: Shunkei-nuri: transparent amber-orange urushi over visible wood grain, honey-to-persimmon inner glow.
description_zh: 春慶塗：透明琥珀漆覆于木纹之上，蜜色至柿色透光。

description_en: Nanako: fish-roe metal ground of tiny uniform circular punches catching raking light.
description_zh: 魚々子地：细密均匀圆点錾地，侧光下如鱼子粒粒。

description_en: Kraka glass: thick crystal with a regular trapped-air bubble grid forming a net inside the mass.
description_zh: 克拉卡玻璃：厚水晶内规则气泡网格如渔网嵌于玻璃体中。

description_en: Flinqué: translucent vitreous enamel over engine-turned metal, engraved waves visible through the glassy skin.
description_zh: 车纹珐琅：半透明珐琅覆于引擎车纹金属上，釉下波纹透光可见。

description_en: Kinkarakami: Japanese gilt leather-paper — gold and colored foils stamped into washi as raised damask relief.
description_zh: 金唐紙：金箔与彩箔压印于和纸，浮凸锦纹如金革。

description_en: Sukashibori: Japanese openwork metal — saw-pierced sheet with negative-space silhouettes and remaining bridges.
description_zh: 透かし彫り：金属板镂空透雕，留桥与负形轮廓透光。

description_en: Linglong: rice-grain porcelain — dense glaze-filled perforations that glow when backlit (hotaru-de).
description_zh: 玲珑瓷：米粒状透雕填釉，背光如萤火（萤手）。

description_en: Plangi: circular tie-dye resist — concentric bound rings and reserved dots in overlapping handmade sunbursts.
description_zh: 圈缬：环形扎染防染，层层手工日晕圈与留白点。

description_en: Lattimo: Venetian opaque milk glass — dense milky white with thin-edge opaline glow and furnace-worked volume.
description_zh: 拉蒂莫乳白：威尼斯乳浊玻璃，厚处密白、薄缘乳光。

description_en: Vernis Martin: 18th-century French layered lacquer — wet high-gloss varnish, gilt chinoiserie, pastel coachwork shine.
description_zh: 维尔尼马丁漆：十八世纪法国多层罩漆，高光湿润、描金唐草、粉彩底。

description_en: Surihaku: Noh-costume gold and silver leaf stamped onto silk — cracked foil fields, metallic pattern on dark ground.
description_zh: 摺箔：能装金箔银箔压印于绸，箔面龟裂、暗地金属纹。

description_en: Inciso glass: wheel-cut incised crystal — parallel grooves, frosted V-cuts, raking light on clear vs satin glass.
description_zh: 阴刻玻璃：砂轮阴刻水晶，平行槽、磨砂V口、掠光清玻对雾面。

description_en: Kogin-zashi: Tsugaru counted-stitch embroidery — indigo even-weave packed with white geometric diamonds and lattices.
description_zh: 津轻小巾刺：靛蓝平织上白线计数几何菱格密绣。

description_en: Millefleurs: late-medieval tapestry ground — thousands of tiny flowers and strawberries woven on a dark verdant field.
description_zh: 千花锦：中世纪晚期挂毯底，深绿地上织满细花与草莓。

description_en: Pointillé: French goldsmith chasing — tonal modeling built from thousands of tiny circular punch-dots on gold and silver.
description_zh: 点錾：法国金工錾点，以密布小圆点在金银上塑造明暗。

description_en: Tamenuri: layered translucent urushi over a dark ground — candy-deep wet sheen from many thin lacquer coats.
description_zh: 溜涂：深色地上多层半透明漆，薄涂积出如糖果般的湿润光泽。

description_en: Pietra Paesina: Florentine ruin marble — dendritic iron staining in limestone that reads as miniature cliffs and ruined towers.
description_zh: 风景石：佛罗伦萨ruin大理石，石灰岩中的铁质树状纹如微型悬崖与废墟。

description_en: Diamond-point engraving: Venetian/Dutch crystal scratched with a diamond stylus — hair-thin sparkling lines on clear glass.
description_zh: 金刚石线刻：威尼斯与荷兰水晶以金刚石针划刻，透明玻璃上极细闪光线。

description_en: Ajouré: French openwork metal — saw-pierced gold and silver sheet with lace-like voids and light through the cutouts.
description_zh: 透雕金工：法国镂空金属，锯穿金银薄片形成蕾丝般负形与透光。

description_en: Kebori: Japanese hairline metal engraving — hair-thin incised lines on dark patinated alloy, silver-cut grooves under raking light.
description_zh: 毛彫：日本极细金属线刻，深色合金上发丝般阴刻线，掠光下银亮沟槽。

description_en: Same-nuri: Japanese sharkskin lacquer — urushi over ray-skin nodules, gloss pooling in valleys, pebbled samegawa grain.
description_zh: 鮫塗：鲨鱼皮漆，漆覆鳐皮颗粒，谷中积光，鮫皮卵石纹理。

description_en: Soap-ground aquatint: etching with milky soap resists and granular aquatint tooth — velvety bitten greys and irregular pale islands on rag paper.
description_zh: 皂地飞尘：皂抗蚀与飞尘颗粒咬蚀，天鹅绒灰调与不规则浅色岛，印于棉浆纸。

description_en: Opus Alexandrinum: geometric opus sectile marble inlay — interlocking triangles and guilloche bands of porphyry, verde antique, and giallo antico.
description_zh: 亚历山大镶嵌：几何板块石嵌，斑岩、古绿与古黄大理石三角与绞丝带严丝合缝。

description_en: Pannotype: 1850s wet-collodion on black waxed linen — cloth weave through the collodion, chocolate-brown shadows, matte fabric support.
description_zh: 布基湿版：1850年代火棉胶涂于黑色蜡布，织物纹透出乳剂，巧克力棕影与哑光布基。

description_en: Choshitsu: carved multilayer urushi — stacked cinnabar, black, ochre and green coats gouged through so stratified color bands form the image.
description_zh: 彫漆：多层堆漆后刀刻，朱红、黑、赭与绿层被剖开，色带断面构成形象。

description_en: Ishime-ji: Japanese stone-grain metal ground — dense pebble punch-marks on iron or shakudo, matte mineral sparkle instead of mirror polish.
description_zh: 石目地：金属石目地，密锤卵石坑点于铁或赤铜，哑光矿物闪光而非镜面抛光。

description_en: Uchidashi: Japanese hammered relief from the reverse of a thin metal sheet — raised volumes, planished fronts, chasing lines, hollow-back copper.
description_zh: 打出：从薄金属背面锤起浮雕，正面锤光，錾线走形，空膛铜面。

description_en: Gu embroidery: Songjiang painting-embroidery — hair-split silk floss, long-and-short stitch painterly shading, satin sheen on silk ground.
description_zh: 顾绣：松江画绣，劈丝细于发，套针晕色如墨染，缎面丝光落于绸地。

description_en: Wothlytype: 1864 uranium-nitrate and silver printing-out process — honey-yellow to olive-brown continuous tone, paper fiber, chemical stain.
description_zh: 沃斯利型：1864年铀盐与银盐晒印，蜜黄至橄榄棕连续调，纸纹与化学渍。

description_en: Aristotype: collodio-chloride printing-out paper — warm chocolate to purple-brown continuous tone, baryta sheen, POP grain.
description_zh: 阿里斯托型：火棉胶氯化银晒印相纸，巧克力至紫棕色连续调，钡地微光与晒印颗粒。

description_en: Aogai: blue-green abalone shell inlay — iridescent teal, cyan and violet nacre tesserae set in black lacquer.
description_zh: 青貝：青绿色鲍贝镶嵌，孔雀绿与紫蓝珠光碎片嵌于黑漆。

description_en: Gold ruby glass: cranberry blown glass colored with gold chloride — deep transparent red, thick-thin pooling, furnace glow.
description_zh: 金红玻璃：金盐着色的深红透明吹制玻璃，厚薄积色与炉火内光。

description_en: Spirit duplicator (ditto): aniline purple-violet on cheap paper, alcohol-solvent bleed, fuzzy edges, school-handout grain.
description_zh: 酒精誊印：苯胺紫墨于薄纸，酒精渗边与模糊套印，讲义纸纹。

description_en: Gota patti: Rajasthani gold-ribbon appliqué — metallic gota strips couched onto silk, geometric zari shimmer, not raised zardozi.
description_zh: 金带绣：拉贾斯坦金带贴绣，金银箔带钉于丝绸，几何闪光而非立体金线绣。

description_en: Broderie Perse: 18th-century English chintz appliqué — cut floral printed-cotton motifs needle-turned onto a plain quilt ground, echo quilting, cloth proud of the field.
description_zh: 印花贴布绣：十八世纪英国印花布贴绣，剪下印花棉布花卉钉于素色绗缝底，回针绗线，布面略凸。

description_en: Mountmellick: Irish whitework — heavy white cotton on white jean, knotted and padded botanical stitches in high relief, no openwork holes.
description_zh: 芒特梅利克白绣：爱尔兰白绣，粗白棉线于白斜纹布，打结垫绣植物纹高浮雕，无抽纱孔洞。

description_en: Thewa: Pratapgarh fused gold-foil on colored glass — pierced 23k gold sheet kiln-fused to ruby and emerald glass, filigree cutouts, not enamel.
description_zh: 特瓦金箔：普拉塔加尔金箔熔于彩玻，镂空二十三开金片窑熔于红绿玻璃，非珐琅。

description_en: Ikkanbari: Japanese washi papier-mâché lacquer — layered paper laminated with urushi over a mold, visible fiber, amber lacquer sheen, hollow lightweight form.
description_zh: 一闲张：日本和纸漆裱纸塑，多层和纸髹漆覆模，纤维可见，琥珀漆光，中空轻体。

description_en: Cuprotype: copper-salt photographic print — reddish-brown to copper-orange continuous tone on rag paper, chemical stain and fiber, not cyanotype blue.
description_zh: 铜盐印相：铜盐摄影印相，红棕至铜橙色连续调，棉纸纤维与药渍，非蓝晒。

description_en: Point de Venise: raised Venetian needle lace — padded cordonnet, picots, brides, baroque scroll fill in sculptural ivory linen thread.
description_zh: 威尼斯针绣：高浮雕针绣花边，加垫轮廓线、皮科结、连接丝与巴洛克卷草，象牙色亚麻线。

description_en: Hira-zōgan: Japanese flat mixed-metal inlay — gold, silver, and copper flush-polished into dark shakudō or iron, level surface, no raised takazōgan.
description_zh: 平象嵌：金银铜平嵌于黑赤铜或铁地，磨至齐平，无高浮雕高象嵌。

description_en: Carrickmacross: Irish cambric appliqué on machine net — needle-run outlines, snipped cloth infills, shamrock and rose on gossamer hexagonal mesh.
description_zh: 卡里克马克罗斯花边：细棉布贴于机制网地上，走针勾边、剪贴填花、三叶草与玫瑰。

description_en: Artigue: late-19th-century direct carbon photographic paper — velvety carbon pigment, matte rag support, deep Dmax, no silver grain and no transfer sheet.
description_zh: 阿蒂格印相：十九世纪末直接碳素相纸，丝绒碳粉、哑光棉纸、深暗部，无银盐颗粒、无转印膜。

description_en: Joly screen: 1894 lined-screen additive color photography — fine vertical RGB ruling over a glass-plate image, muted early-color dyes, not Autochrome dots.
description_zh: 乔利线屏：1894年线屏加色摄影，玻璃干版上细密红绿蓝竖线，早期淡色，非奥托克罗姆色点。

description_en: Pinatype: early dye-imbibition color print — soft gelatin-soaked dyes, slight layer misregister, watercolor-stained paper tooth, not Autochrome dots.
description_zh: 皮纳型：早期染料渗印彩色照片，明胶吸色、轻微套色错位、水彩渍纸纹，非奥托克罗姆色点。

description_en: Istoriato: Renaissance narrative maiolica — tin-glaze white ground, cobalt/antimony/copper/manganese overglaze, dark outlines on tin-glazed earthenware.
description_zh: 叙事彩陶：文艺复兴叙事马约利卡，锡白釉地，钴蓝锑黄铜绿锰紫釉上彩，锡釉陶上深色勾线。

description_en: Schwalm: German whitework on evenweave linen — coral-stitch outlines, satin leaves, pulled-thread and needle-lace fillings, white-on-white only.
description_zh: 施瓦尔姆白绣：德国本白亚麻白绣，珊瑚针勾边、缎针叶片、抽纱与针绣填芯，仅白线白布。

description_en: Tole painting: folk enamel on japanned tin — one-stroke comma brushes, vermilion and gold on asphaltum-black metal, visible brush ridges, not oil portrait.
description_zh: 铁皮彩绘：黑漆铁皮上的民间珐琅笔法，一笔逗号描、朱红描金沥青黑底，可见笔脊，非油画肖像。

description_en: Point de Gaze: Belgian needle lace — fine gauze réseau, raised rose-point petals, cordonnet and picots, airy ivory mesh, not heavy Point de Venise.
description_zh: 纱地针绣：比利时针绣花边，极细纱网地、浮雕玫瑰瓣、加粗轮廓与小皮寇，轻透牙白，非厚重威尼斯针绣。

description_en: Gnathia ware: Hellenistic black-gloss pottery with added white, yellow and purple overpaint, incised vinework, kiln sheen — not red-figure.
description_zh: 格纳西亚陶：希腊化黑釉陶，白黄紫加彩、刻划藤蔓、窑光釉面，非红绘。

description_en: Chromoskedasic painting: silver-gelatin color-by-light-scattering, metallic interference golds magentas cyans, lith-like pepper grain, chemical bloom.
description_zh: 散射显影：银盐明胶散射成色，金洋红青金属干涉色、石版般椒盐颗粒、药液晕边。

description_en: Kirigane: cut squares and lozenges of gold and silver leaf pasted as a tessellated field on mineral pigment, raking-light facets — not solid gilding.
description_zh: 切金：裁切金箔银箔方片菱片贴成嵌金网格，矿物颜料底、侧光闪面，非整铺贴金。

description_en: Flexography: photopolymer relief plate, anilox-metered spot inks, slight ink squash and soft registration, packaging-print solids — not offset, not risograph.
description_zh: 柔性版印刷：感光树脂凸版、网纹辊计量专色、轻微溢墨与套准偏移、包装实地色块，非胶印、非孔版。

description_en: Venetian plaster: multilayer lime putty and marble dust, trowel-burnished marmorino sheen, waxed ochre veining — not buon fresco, not carved marble.
description_zh: 威尼斯灰泥：多层石灰膏与大理石粉、抹刀抛光灰泥光泽、蜡面赭石纹理，非湿壁画、非大理石圆雕。

description_en: Palissy ware: rustic lead-glazed earthenware with high-relief life-cast shells, fish and plants, pooled honey and copper-green glazes — not istoriato, not porcelain.
description_zh: 帕利西陶：高浮雕写生贝壳鱼虫的铅釉陶，蜜色与铜绿釉积于凹处，非叙事彩陶、非瓷塑。

description_en: Sabattier effect: darkroom pseudo-solarization with partial tonal reversal, Mackie lines and silver-gelatin grain — not digital invert, not neon glow.
description_zh: 萨巴蒂效应：暗房伪日晒，局部影调反转、麦基线与银盐颗粒，非数字反相、非霓虹。

description_en: Pingtuo: Tang lacquer with cut gold and silver foil inlaid and polished flush to the surface — not kirigane tesserae, not sprinkled maki-e, not incised chinkin.
description_zh: 平脱：唐代漆器，裁切金银箔嵌平打磨与漆面齐平，非切金方片、非莳绘洒金、非沉金刻线。

description_en: Mocha ware: banded earthenware with acid-dendrite mocha moss — tree-like slip branching on factory-turned color bands — not agateware, not neriage.
description_zh: 树枝纹陶：色带化妆土上酸蚀树枝纹（摩卡苔），工厂旋坯色带，非玛瑙陶、非练上。

description_en: Saint-Porchaire ware: Renaissance inlaid pipe-clay strapwork and arabesques in darker clay under a thin honey glaze — not painted maiolica, not niello.
description_zh: 圣波谢尔陶：文艺复兴白管土嵌饰于深色胎，书装压印卷草与细带，薄蜜釉，非彩绘马约利卡、非黑金。

description_en: Vortograph: Coburn-style vorticism photograph through three mirrors — kaleidoscopic shards, repeating crystalline facets, high-contrast grain; not digital glitch, not cubist paint.
description_zh: 涡旋摄影：科伯恩式三镜万花筒摄影，结晶碎面重复、高反差颗粒，非数字故障、非立体主义油画。

description_en: Schlieren imaging: knife-edge visualization of refractive-index gradients — heat plumes and shock ripples as silver-black contour bands; not CGI glass, not x-ray.
description_zh: 纹影：刀口法折射率梯度成像，热羽与激波呈银黑等高条纹，非玻璃着色渲染、非X光。

description_en: Petzval swirl: 19th-century Petzval lens — sharp center, rotating elliptical bokeh, brass-era optical aberration; not tilt-shift miniature, not gaussian blur.
description_zh: 佩兹伐旋焦：十九世纪佩兹伐镜头，中心锐利、椭圆散景旋转，非移轴微缩、非高斯虚化。

description_en: Dead coloring: oil underpainting locked in raw umber, mute lead-tin yellow and terra verte — lean matte, no final glaze chroma; not grisaille silver, not finished color oil.
description_zh: 死色层：油画底层定在生赭、铅锡黄与土绿，无罩染色彩，非银灰色单色、非完成油彩。

description_en: Lenticular print: ribbed plastic lenticules, interlaced dual-angle ghosting, glossy molded-lens stripes; not anaglyph red-cyan, not rainbow hologram.
description_zh: 光栅立体：柱镜条纹互织双角残影，塑胶透镜反光，非红青立体、非彩虹全息。

description_en: Fundame: dense matte gold-powder urushi ground, unsown kinpun as a velvet metallic field, unpolished; not nashiji speckles, not burnished ikakeji, not pictorial maki-e.
description_zh: 粉地：密铺无光金粉漆地，丝绒金属质感，未经研磨；非梨地金斑、非沃悬地抛光、非绘莳绘。

description_en: Papel picado: punched tissue-paper banners, translucent stacked color, light through negative-space cuts; not Chinese jianzhi, not scherenschnitte silhouette, not kirigami folds.
description_zh: 镂空彩纸：薄纸穿孔彩幡，叠色透光负形剪孔；非中国剪纸、非黑影剪影、非立体切纸。

description_en: Pastel manner: 18th-c intaglio imitating chalk pastel, roulette grain and dusty stipple in limited chalky inks on laid paper; not actual pastel, not lithotint, not crayon manner alone.
description_zh: 粉彩凹版：十八世纪模仿粉彩的铜版，滚点颗粒与粉尘点刻，有限粉色印于布纹纸；非真粉彩、非石版淡彩、非单独粉笔凹版。

description_en: Hishizashi: Nanbu counted diamond sashiko, white running-stitch hishi lattice on indigo hemp; not kogin-zashi, not hitomezashi, not wave sashiko.
description_zh: 菱刺：南部计数菱格刺子，白线在靛蓝麻上走针成菱；非小巾刺、非一目刺子、非波浪刺子。

description_en: Opaline glass: milky translucent 19th-c French furnace glass, pastel body with fiery edge opalescence; not lattimo opaque white, not millefiori, not pâte-de-verre granules.
description_zh: 乳浊玻璃：十九世纪法国半透明乳浊炉制玻璃，粉彩色体与薄边火彩；非拉蒂莫不透明白、非千花、非熔铸玻璃颗粒。

description_en: Diazotype: ammonia-developed diazo whiteprint / blueline — aniline-blue chemical line on cream paper, graphic architectural-print grain; not cyanotype Prussian wash, not van dyke brown.
description_zh: 重氮蓝图：氨显影重氮白图/蓝线，米色纸上的苯胺蓝化学线条与工程图纸颗粒；非蓝晒普鲁士蓝底、非凡戴克棕。

description_en: Pennellate: Murano hot-glass with painterly color swipes trapped in a clear matrix — molten cobalt, amber, and rose veils; not filigrana threads, not incalmo joins, not murrine slices.
description_zh: 笔触玻璃：穆拉诺热玻璃中封入画笔般色带，钴蓝、琥珀与玫红色幕；非菲利格拉纳细丝、非对接熔接、非穆林切片。

description_en: Kirlian photography: high-voltage corona discharge contact print — neon-violet streamers on black, Lichtenberg branching, photographic grain; not neon signage, not schlieren, not chemigram.
description_zh: 克尔利安电晕：高压电晕接触印相，黑底上的紫青电须与利希滕贝格分叉、底片颗粒；非霓虹招牌、非纹影、非化学显影画。

description_en: Whieldon ware: 18th-c Staffordshire clouded tortoiseshell lead glaze — manganese brown, copper green, antimony yellow fused on cream earthenware; not mocha dendritic tea, not agateware laminated clay.
description_zh: 惠尔登云釉：十八世纪斯塔福德玳瑁铅釉，锰棕、铜绿与锑黄熔于奶油色陶体；非摩卡树枝纹、非玛瑙陶夹色泥。

description_en: Yuteki: oil-spot tenmoku — glossy iron-black Jian glaze with silvery oil-drop crystallites; not hare’s-fur streaks, not yohen starbursts, not tea-dust matte.
description_zh: 油滴釉：铁黑建盏天目上的银色油滴析晶；非兔毫条纹、非曜变星斑、非茶叶末亚光。

description_en: Parian ware: unglazed marble-white biscuit porcelain, satiny bisque bloom, faint translucency at thin edges; not glazed bone china, not Carrara marble, not plaster cast.
description_zh: 帕里安瓷：无釉大理石白素烧瓷，缎面粉光与薄处微透；非釉面骨瓷、非卡拉拉大理石、非石膏模。

description_en: Black basalt: Wedgwood-type matte unglazed black stoneware, dry mineral sheen, engine-turned relief; not glazed jet, not bronze, not mezzotint.
description_zh: 黑玄武陶：韦奇伍德式无釉哑光黑炻器，矿物干光与车花浮纹；非亮釉煤玉、非青铜、非美柔汀。

description_en: Cristallo: Venetian Renaissance soda glass decolorized with manganese — diamond-bright, paper-thin walls, faint straw tint at rims; not cristallo-cut crystal lead glass, not ice glass, not lattimo.
description_zh: 水晶玻璃：威尼斯文艺复兴钠钙玻璃，锰脱色，薄壁如纸、口沿微麦秆色；非铅晶切面、非冰裂玻璃、非拉蒂莫乳白。

description_en: Natural wood-ash glaze: wood-fired olive-amber runs, kiln-flash blushes, glassy pooling in recesses; not celadon feldspathic green, not tenmoku iron-black, not salt glaze orange-peel.
description_zh: 灰釉：柴烧草木灰釉，橄榄琥珀流淌与火痕潮红、凹处玻璃积釉；非长石青瓷、非铁黑天目、非盐釉橘皮。

description_en: Marouflage: oil on canvas glued to architecture — visible weave, lead-white adhesion, mural-scale wall curve; not buon fresco into wet plaster, not tapestry, not easel oil.
description_zh: 贴布壁画：油画布贴墙，可见织纹、铅白胶粘与建筑弧面；非湿壁画入灰、非挂毯、非架上油画。

description_en: Mishima inlay: incised stoneware filled with white slip, stamped punch-marks, buncheong-like fired surface; not sgraffito scratch-through, not blue-and-white porcelain, not drawing on paper.
description_zh: 三岛镶嵌：炻器阴刻填白化妆土、戳印纹与烧成器表；非刮花露胎、非青花瓷、非纸上线描。

description_en: Nunomezuri: woodblock cloth-grain impression in washi, baren-pressed weave tooth, muted mineral blocks; not embroidery, not canvas oil, not digital noise.
description_zh: 布目摺：木版布纹压入和纸、马连压出织纹与矿物色块；非刺绣、非布面油画、非数字噪点。

description_en: Iwa-enogu: crushed mineral Nihonga pigments—malachite, azurite, cinnabar, gofun—gritty matte stone color on washi; not watercolor wash, not acrylic, not cel.
description_zh: 岩绘具：日本画矿物色，孔雀石、石青、朱砂与胡粉，纸上粗粒哑光；非水彩渲染、非丙烯、非赛璐珞。

description_en: Grisaille glass: vitreous grey-brown tracing and matting on translucent panes, silver stain, lead calmes; not oil grisaille on canvas, not ink wash, not jewel mosaic only.
description_zh: 灰色玻璃画：玻璃上烧制灰棕描线与罩色、银染与铅条；非布面灰色画、非水墨、非仅宝石色镶嵌。

description_en: Tula work: Russian niello in engraved silver, matte black chern against polished metal; not paper engraving, not mezzotint, not enamel.
description_zh: 图拉乌银：银器阴刻填乌银，哑光黑衬抛光银地；非纸上雕版、非美柔汀、非珐琅。

description_en: Ébauche: academic first lay-in of thin oil on a toned ground, blocky values and unfinished edges; not Impressionist broken color, not glazed finish, not grisaille.
description_zh: 铺色底稿：学院派薄油铺大色，色块未完成、边缘溶于底色；非印象派笔触分离、非罩染完成、非灰色底层。

description_en: Tsuya-zuri: ukiyo-e burnished gloss printing, selected planes polished with a baren to wet-lacquer sheen; not kirazuri mica sparkle, not oil glaze, not cel shine.
description_zh: 艶摺：浮世绘马连砑光，局部色块磨出湿漆般高光；非云母摺闪光、非油画罩染、非赛璐璐高光。

description_en: Bullicante: Murano glass with a regular lattice of trapped air bubbles and optical refraction; not random pulegoso foam, not millefiori canes, not stained-glass leading.
description_zh: 网格气泡：穆拉诺玻璃规则气泡阵与折射光点；非无序泡沫玻璃、非千花玻璃、非镶铅彩窗。

description_en: Smocking: regularly gathered fabric with honeycomb and surface-grid embroidery on tight pleats; not trapunto padding, not sashiko running stitch, not bargello.
description_zh: 缩褶绣：规律抽褶上的蜂巢与网格绣线；非填充绗缝、非刺子绣、非火焰针。

description_en: Taka-zogan: Japanese raised metal inlay, gold and silver standing proud of a dark iron or shakudō ground; not flush hira-zogan, not nunome-zogan mesh, not niello.
description_zh: 高肉镶嵌：金银高浮雕嵌于铁或赤铜地，镶件高出底面；非平嵌、非布目镶嵌、非乌银。

description_en: Chirimen-e: Japanese crêped woodblock — a finished nishiki-e is dampened and pressed into a textured mold so the sheet puckers like crepe silk; not plain mokuhanga, not karazuri blind emboss, not chirimen textile.
description_zh: 缩缅绘：完成的锦绘经湿压起皱，纸面如绉绸细褶；非普通水印木刻、非空摺、非缩缅织物。

description_en: Sơn mài: Vietnamese polished lacquer painting — layered black and cinnabar lacquer inlaid with crushed eggshell and gold leaf, then sanded to a wet glassy sheen; not Japanese maki-e, not Chinese diaoqi, not oil glaze.
description_zh: 磨漆画：多层黑漆与朱红嵌蛋壳金箔，打磨至镜面；非莳绘、非雕漆、非油画罩染。

description_en: Grottesche: Renaissance grotesque ornament after the Domus Aurea and Vatican Loggia — airy candelabra, hybrid scrolls, and fresco figures on a pale ground; not Baroque heaviness, not Art Nouveau, not horror grotesques.
description_zh: 怪诞纹样：文艺复兴壁饰，灯台式卷草与湿壁画人物铺于浅地；非巴洛克厚重、非新艺术、非恐怖怪诞。

description_en: Mezen painting: Northern Russian folk painting in iron-red and lamp-black on pale wood — horses, deer, birds, and geometric friezes with hatched fills; not Khokhloma gold, not Gzhel blue, not Palekh lacquer.
description_zh: 梅津彩绘：俄国北方民间红黑彩绘，马鹿鸟与几何饰带铺于浅木地；非霍赫洛玛金地、非格热利蓝、非帕列赫漆。

description_en: Lai rot nam: Thai gold-wash lacquer — resist drawing on black lacquer, gold leaf applied, then water-washed so gold remains only in the design; not Japanese maki-e sprinkle, not raden, not niello.
description_zh: 水洗金漆：泰国黑漆抗蚀描金，水洗后金仅留于纹样；非莳绘洒金、非螺钿、非乌银。

description_en: Incised-line lacquer packed with gold powder; raking-light gilt grooves on polished cinnabar and black urushi.
description_zh: 漆面阴刻细线填金粉，朱红与黑漆上呈掠光金线。

description_en: Cape Dorset stone-block relief print: grainy ink, flat unmodulated color, bold contours on cream paper.
description_zh: 开普多塞特石刻浮雕版，颗粒油墨、平涂色块、粗轮廓印于米纸。

description_en: Murano glass with parallel cane stripes fused through the melt; optical filigree and furnace gloss.
description_zh: 穆拉诺平行玻璃丝熔入器体，光学条纹与窑火光泽。

description_en: Iron-red overglaze enamel on white porcelain; spare red brush, glaze sheen, empty white fields.
description_zh: 白瓷上铁红釉上彩，疏笔红线、釉光与大面积留白。

description_en: Polaroid emulsion peeled and transferred; wrinkled translucent film skin on textured paper.
description_zh: 宝丽来乳剂膜剥离转印，褶皱半透明胶膜覆于纸面。

description_en: Murano excavated-look glass: acid-fumed pits, mineral crust, iridescent scum, smoky celadon body.
description_zh: 穆拉诺发掘玻璃：酸雾麻点、矿壳、虹彩薄垢、烟青瓷色玻璃体。

description_en: Carved lacquer recesses filled with polychrome qi, polished flush into nested color cells.
description_zh: 剔刻凹槽填入彩漆，打磨齐平，嵌套色格如漆嵌。

description_en: Lithography on zinc: greasy crayon, tusche wash, cool gray-black ink on cream paper.
description_zh: 锌版石版：油脂蜡笔、油墨洗、冷灰黑印于乳白纸。

description_en: Braj cut-paper stencil: lace-like negative filigree, dry pigment sifted through the cuts.
description_zh: 布拉杰镂纸漏绘：负形花丝、干粉从切口筛落成画。

description_en: Mopa-mopa resin films cut and inlaid in botanical layers, gloss varnish over gold and green leaf.
description_zh: 莫帕树脂薄膜剪贴镶嵌，植物层叠，金绿箔上罩亮漆。

description_en: 19th-century color wood engraving: end-grain hatch, registered color blocks, dry inks on cream paper.
description_zh: 十九世纪彩色木口木刻：木口排线、套色色块、干燥油墨印于乳色纸。

description_en: Intaglio key-plate overprinted with glossy oil-color woodblocks, raised pigment, paper show-through in lights.
description_zh: 凹版主版叠印油彩木版色块，颜料微凸，高光透纸。

description_en: Cut printed-paper motifs glued in layers, scissor edges, many coats of yellowed varnish.
description_zh: 印刷纸样剪贴层叠，可见刀口，多层微黄罩漆。

description_en: Igbo uli: calligraphic indigo-black curvilinear glyphs, spirals and lizards on pale clay ground.
description_zh: 伊博乌利：靛蓝黑书法曲线纹、螺旋与蜥蜴，浅陶土地。

description_en: Swedish kurbits folk painting: oversized fantasy blooms, curling stems, flat Dalarna tempera on cream.
description_zh: 瑞典库尔比茨民间彩绘：夸张幻想花、卷草、达拉纳平涂蛋彩于乳白底。

description_en: Japanese lacquer with geometric tin and lead inlay: silver tesserae, lattice, and lozenges set into mirror-black urushi.
description_zh: 日本漆艺以锡铅细嵌几何纹：银灰色菱格与格子嵌于镜面黑漆。

description_en: Meiji mixed-material inlay: ivory, stained ivory, mother-of-pearl, coral and horn carved in high relief on lacquer.
description_zh: 明治混材镶嵌：象牙、染色象牙、螺钿、珊瑚与角质高浮雕嵌于漆地。

description_en: Italian maiolica on a blue-tinted tin glaze, painted in bianco-sopra-bianco, cobalt, ochre and copper-green ceramic pigments.
description_zh: 意大利马略卡蓝染锡釉地，以白上白、钴蓝、赭石与铜绿釉上彩绘制。

description_en: Nineteenth-century earthenware decorated with sponge-spattered color fields and simple folk drawing on a cream glaze.
description_zh: 十九世纪陶器以海绵泼点色块，奶油釉上配简朴民间线绘。

description_en: Trompe-l'oeil painted marble: glazed oil scumbles and calcite veining imitating polished stone panels, not carved stone.
description_zh: 错视仿大理石绘：油彩罩染与方解石纹路模仿抛光石板，而非真石雕刻。

description_en: Małopolska cottage painting: whitewashed walls packed with naïve roses, dotted stems, and folk birds in saturated red, green, yellow, and cobalt.
description_zh: 波兰小波兰乡居彩绘：粉白墙面铺满稚拙玫瑰、点状茎叶与民俗飞鸟，红绿黄钴饱和平涂。

description_en: Wedgwood iridescent overglaze: mother-of-pearl, ruby, and gold lustre with outlined ornamental trees on a glossy fired-ceramic skin.
description_zh: 韦奇伍德仙境虹彩：珍珠母、宝石红与金光虹彩釉，勾线饰树覆于光亮瓷表。

description_en: Scandinavian wood incision: knife-cut grooves in pale birch packed with dark bark dust, geometric and floral linework over visible grain.
description_zh: 北欧木面刻纹：白桦细刀刻槽填入深色树皮粉，几何与花卉线描叠在木纹之上。

description_en: Art Nouveau ceramic: raised slip piped as cloison walls, cells filled with pooled glossy glazes that catch light on the ridges.
description_zh: 新艺术陶瓷堆线：泥浆挤成隔墙，格内灌注光亮釉色，脊线受光如景泰蓝。

description_en: Mino/Seto ashen glaze: milky bluish-grey pooling, quiet satin ceramic skin, ash blush and pinholes — not tenmoku, not bright celadon.
description_zh: 美浓濑户御深井：乳青灰灰釉垂流，哑光瓷肤带灰晕与针孔，非天目亦非翠青瓷。

description_en: Leaf-resist tenmoku: a real mulberry leaf fused into iron-black Jian glaze, golden vein fossil, oil-spot and hare's-fur ground.
description_zh: 木叶天目：桑叶贴烧入铁黑建盏釉，金褐叶脉化石，油滴与兔毫为地。

description_en: Korean ox-horn inlay: dyed translucent horn sheets reverse-painted and set flush in dark lacquer, amber glow and mineral color.
description_zh: 华角：薄牛角染色反绘，嵌于深漆地，琥珀透光与矿物彩。

description_en: White linen cutwork: buttonhole-edged voids, picot bars, raised white-on-white openwork with sculptural negative space.
description_zh: 黎塞留雕绣：锁边镂空、珠饰连接档、浮雕白绣与负形空间。

description_en: Bohemian high-relief glass cutting: figures standing proud in undercut crystal, polished peaks vs matte ground, ruby overlay flash.
description_zh: 高浮雕玻璃：深掏底使形象凸出晶面，抛光高点对哑光地，套红闪边。

description_en: Gold-wire network fused into glass, cells filled with translucent jewel enamel — 17th-c. émail en résille sur verre.
description_zh: 网丝珐琅：金丝网熔入玻璃，格内填透明宝石珐琅，十七世纪玻璃网丝珐琅。

description_en: Bizen straw-cord firing: rice straw burns scarlet lattice scars into unglazed iron clay — hidasuki fire-marks, no glaze pool.
description_zh: 緋襷：稻草捆烧在无釉铁质陶胎上留下朱红绳痕与火纹，无釉池。

description_en: Kiln-slumped sheet glass: gravity drapes panes over a mold, fire-polished rims, trapped seed bubbles, optical sag — not lampwork or pate-de-verre.
description_zh: 热弯玻璃：平板玻璃窑中塌陷覆模，火抛光边、气泡与光学下垂，非灯工亦非粉熔。

description_en: 19th-c sequential motion on one plate: Marey/Muybridge shutter-sliced phases, gelatin-silver studio ground, time as discrete poses.
description_zh: 连续分相摄影：马雷/迈布里奇式单底多瞬间，明胶银盐棚拍黑地，动势切成离散姿势。

description_en: Alpine peasant furniture painting: flat opaque tempera on wood, tulip-rose-scrolls, folk reds greens ochre, black outline, panel grain.
description_zh: 农民彩绘：阿尔卑斯家具彩绘，不透明胶彩、郁金香与卷草、民红民绿赭石、黑线与木纹地。

description_en: Vietnamese Đông Hồ folk woodcut on diep oyster-shell paper: rustic vermilion, yellow, lampblack, bold carved outline, village misregister.
description_zh: 东湖木版：越南东湖民刻，蜃粉纸地、朱红黄黑限色、粗刻线与民间套印偏移。

description_en: Rathwa wall mural, stacked horse registers, flat earth pigments on white clay.
description_zh: 拉特瓦壁画、层叠马队、白泥墙上的平涂土色颜料。

description_en: Rajasthani rice-paste geometry, white lime line on red-ochre geru ground.
description_zh: 拉贾斯坦米粉几何纹、红赭地上的白石灰线描。

description_en: Late-Edo ukiyo-e without bright beni red; ashen blue, olive, mustard woodblock.
description_zh: 江户末期忌红浮世绘、灰蓝橄榄与芥黄木版套色。

description_en: Kutch raised castor-oil paint, metallic beaded florals on dark cotton.
description_zh: 库奇蓖麻油堆绘、深色棉布上的金属感串珠花纹。

description_en: Kholuy lacquer miniature, painterly folk-tale color on glossy black papier-mâché.
description_zh: 霍卢伊漆微型画、黑漆纸胎上偏写实的民间叙事彩绘。

description_en: Sohrai harvest mural: white kaolin ground, ochre and manganese, comb- and finger-painted animals on earthen plaster.
description_zh: 索赫莱收获壁画：高岭土白地、赭石与锰黑、梳纹与手指绘出的泥墙动物纹样。

description_en: Guler Pahari miniature: hair-thin outline, cool green hills, lyrical wash and jewel-like flat architecture.
description_zh: 古勒帕哈里细密画：发丝细线、冷绿山丘、抒情渲染与平面建筑。

description_en: Qing yangcai painted enamel: glossy porcelain, Western-influenced overglaze shading, famille-rose and gilt.
description_zh: 清代洋彩：瓷白地、西洋明暗的釉上彩、粉彩与描金。

description_en: Mezzo fresco: mineral pigment into half-dry lime plaster, matte bloom, colors slightly bitten by intonaco.
description_zh: 半湿壁画：矿物颜料画入半干灰泥、亚光粉霜、色彩被薄涂灰层轻轻咬住。

description_en: Classic Mimbres black-on-white pottery painting: iron-black figures, hatched fills, geometric frames on slipped ground.
description_zh: 明布雷斯经典黑白陶绘：铁黑人物、排线填充、几何边框画在化妆土白地上。

description_en: Plains ledger drawing: colored pencil and crayon on lined antique account paper, contour figures, flat unmodeled fills.
description_zh: 平原账本画：彩色铅笔与蜡笔绘于带格老账纸上，轮廓人物、平涂无明暗。

description_en: Karma Gadri thangka school: spacious pale mineral landscape, atmospheric distance, airy line, landscape-dominant composition.
description_zh: 噶玛嘎知唐卡画派：疏朗矿物淡景、空气远近、轻盈线描、风景主导构图。

description_en: 19th-century Calcutta Battala woodcut: thick gouged black line, limited hand-tinted flats, coarse paper, slight color misregister.
description_zh: 十九世纪加尔各答巴特拉木刻：粗黑刻线、有限手涂平色、粗纸、套色微错位。

description_en: Ottoman saz yolu drawing: long serrated saz leaves, rumi palmettes, hatayi blossoms, ink and gold on cream paper.
description_zh: 奥斯曼萨兹纹：修长锯齿萨兹叶、鲁米掌纹、哈塔伊花、墨金绘于米纸。

description_en: Etruscan tomb mural: terracotta-red and cream fresco, black outline, flat mineral color, wave and palmette borders.
description_zh: 伊特鲁里亚墓室壁画：陶红与米黄湿壁、黑轮廓、矿物平涂、波浪与掌叶边饰。

description_en: Glazed chintz print: madder, indigo and tea-brown florals, birds and scrolling vines on cream cotton, slightly misregistered woodblock fills.
description_zh: 釉光钦茨印花：茜红、靛蓝与茶褐花卉、小鸟与卷藤于米白棉布，木版套色略有错位。

description_en: Pictorialist exhibition print: gum-bichromate softness, olive-brown midtones, atmospheric haze, selective focus and pigment grain.
description_zh: 画意摄影展览印相：树胶重铬酸盐柔焦、橄榄褐中间调、空气透视、选择性对焦与颜料颗粒。

description_en: Chilean arpillera: hessian ground, scrap-fabric appliqué, embroidery outlines, running and blanket stitch, layered cloth relief.
description_zh: 智利麻布贴绣：麻袋底布、碎布贴花、绣线轮廓、平针与锁边针、层叠布料浮雕。

description_en: Meiji mōrōtai: hazy mineral-pigment wash, dissolved outlines, atmospheric color veils, wet-on-wet nihonga without hard contour.
description_zh: 明治朦胧体：矿物颜料晕染、轮廓消融、空气色幕、无硬线湿画日本画。

description_en: Mstera lacquer miniature: tempera on glossy black papier-mâché, pale lyrical folk color, gold ornament, fine village landscape.
description_zh: 姆斯乔拉漆画：黑亮纸浆胎上的蛋彩细密、浅淡民俗色、金饰边、精细村落风景。

description_en: Senufo Korhogo cloth: mud and plant dyes on raw cotton, iron-black and ochre glyphs, sawtooth borders, matte woven ground.
description_zh: 科霍戈布绘：生棉上的泥染与植物染料、铁黑赭石图腾、锯齿边、哑光织纹底。

description_en: Korean ottchil lacquer painting: many polished urushi layers, wet black-amber gloss, cinnabar and gold dust, nacre flecks.
description_zh: 韩国漆绘：多层抛光大漆、湿润黑琥珀光泽、朱砂与金粉、螺钿细闪。

description_en: Kütahya underglaze ceramic: white tin glaze, tomato red, lemon yellow, cobalt, apple green, manganese, black contour, floral tile.
description_zh: 库塔希亚彩陶：白锡釉、番茄红与柠檬黄、钴蓝苹果绿、锰紫黑线、花卉瓷绘。

description_en: Persian qalamzani metal chasing: incised brass and copper, punched ground, islimi arabesque, burin hatching, gold-on-metal sheen.
description_zh: 波斯錾刻：黄铜红铜阴刻、敲点地纹、伊斯利米卷草、雕刀排线、金属金光。

description_en: Yobitsugi ceramic joinery: mismatched glaze shards fitted with gold urushi seams, mixed celadon, cobalt, and iron-brown fragments.
description_zh: 呼接：异釉瓷片金漆拼合、青瓷钴蓝铁褐碎片、金漆接缝网络。

description_en: Basotho litema mural: comb-grooved earthen plaster, chevron and diamond furrows, lime-white, red clay, ochre, charcoal, low-relief wall geometry.
description_zh: 巴索托利特玛壁画：梳刮泥灰、人字菱形沟纹、石灰白红土赭石木炭、浅浮雕墙面几何。

description_en: Korean najeonchilgi: iridescent mother-of-pearl and abalone inlaid in black-red urushi, gold dust, nacre flash, high-polish lacquer field.
description_zh: 韩国螺钿嵌漆：鲍鱼贝虹彩嵌黑红漆、金粉、珠母闪光、高抛光漆面。

description_en: Yangliuqing nianhua: Tianjin woodblock key-line plus hand-colored mineral washes, rosy cheeks, peony-cloud borders, rice-paper tooth.
description_zh: 杨柳青年画：天津墨线版加手绘矿彩、红颜、牡丹祥云边饰、宣纸纸纹。

description_en: Khovar harvest mural: comb-incised white kaolin over red ochre and black earth, S-curve vines and animal glyphs, matte mud plaster.
description_zh: 科瓦尔收获壁画：白高岭土梳刻于红赭黑土、S形藤蔓与鸟兽符号、哑光泥墙。

description_en: Fukinuki-yatai Yamato-e space: blown-off roofs, high oblique interiors, diagonal screens, gold cloud bands, mineral pigments on silk.
description_zh: 吹拔屋台：屋顶揭去的斜俯室内、斜向障子、金云霞带、绢本矿物颜料。

description_en: Kené vision painting: Shipibo-Konibo labyrinth paths, nested crosses and waves in black, brick-red, and cream reed-pen lines on cotton.
description_zh: 肯内纹绘：希皮博迷宫路径、嵌套十字与波浪，黑、砖红、米白芦笔线绘于棉布。

description_en: Tobi-kanna chatter: skipping comb on white slip over iron-brown stoneware, crescent gouges, stamped dots, Koishiwara–Onta ware tooth.
description_zh: 飞鉋：白化妆土上跳刀梳纹、铁褐胎、新月刨痕与戳点，小石原/小鹿田陶器质。

description_en: Luntaya acheik: Burmese tapestry-woven horizontal wave bands in ruby, emerald, gold, and indigo silk, interlocking weft with no outlines.
description_zh: 波浪纹织：缅甸织锦水平波浪纬带，红宝、翠绿、金与靛蓝丝绸互锁无轮廓。

description_en: Tenango embroidery: Otomí fill-stitch flora and fauna in electric pink, turquoise, lemon, and scarlet on cream muslin, no black outlines.
description_zh: 特南戈绣绘：奥托米平绣动植物，电粉、松石、柠檬与猩红填满米白棉布、无黑线。

description_en: Dongba pictograph painting: Naxi manuscript line, malachite, cinnabar, azurite, and lampblack on mulberry paper, flat registers.
description_zh: 东巴画：纳西经卷线描，石绿、朱砂、石青与烟墨绘于构皮纸、分层平涂。

description_en: Oil on panel with inlaid mother-of-pearl tesserae, umber glazes, nacre shimmer.
description_zh: 木板油画嵌贝片、棕釉罩染、珍珠层闪光。

description_en: Odisha Saura mural: red-ochre plaster, white lime pictographs, ritual wall registers.
description_zh: 奥里萨索拉壁画：赭红墙面、白灰象形、仪式壁带。

description_en: Kutch Lippan kaam: raised white mud relief, inset circular mirrors, lime arabesques.
description_zh: 卡奇利潘泥作：白泥浮线、嵌圆镜、石灰卷草。

description_en: Gold leaf under paint, scratched and punched to imitate brocade on polychrome sculpture.
description_zh: 金箔罩彩后刮刻点錾，仿织锦的彩绘雕像技法。

description_en: Santhal jadupatua scroll: earth-red and yellow mineral fills, bold contour, panel rhythm.
description_zh: 桑塔尔贾杜帕图亚卷轴：土黄矿物填色、粗轮廓、分格节奏。

description_en: Ottoman tezhip illumination: burnished gold leaf, rumi palmettes, hatayi blossoms, lapis and malachite mineral pigments, ruled gold frames.
description_zh: 奥斯曼特兹希普泥金细饰：烫金底、鲁米卷草、哈塔伊莲纹、青金石与孔雀石矿物颜料、金线边栏。

description_en: Balinese Pengosekan school: dense flora-and-fauna fill, fine black outlines, muted earth pigments, tapestry-like decorative naturalism.
description_zh: 巴厘彭戈塞坎画派：密铺花鸟藤叶、细黑勾线、沉着土色颜料、织毯般装饰性自然主义。

description_en: Suzhou Taohuawu nianhua woodblock: bold key-block outlines, hand-colored folk pigments, decorative borders, slightly misregistered flats.
description_zh: 苏州桃花坞年画：墨线主版、手填民间颜料、装饰边栏、套色微错位的平面色块。

description_en: Huichol nierika yarn painting: yarns pressed into beeswax, concentric sacred-geometry color lines, no brushstroke, mosaic yarn surface.
description_zh: 惠乔尔尼耶里卡绒绘：纱线压入蜂蜡、同心圣几何色线、无笔触、马赛克绒面。

description_en: Samoan siapo barkcloth painting: beaten tapa fiber, upeti rubbing-board geometry, brown-black-rust plant dyes, matte cloth surface.
description_zh: 萨摩西亚波树皮布绘：捶打楮皮纤维、印花板几何纹、棕黑锈色植物染料、哑光布面。

description_en: Gujarati ritual shrine-cloth painting: handloom cotton, maroon-black mineral dyes, block-printed outlines filled by hand, folk figures and floral borders.
description_zh: 古吉拉特祭坛布绘：手织棉布、褐红与黑色矿物染料、木版勾线手填、民俗人物与花卉边饰。

description_en: Ukrainian wax-resist dye painting: layered aniline baths, fine wax-line geometry of stars diamonds wheat and sun, lacquered saturated color fields.
description_zh: 乌克兰蜡防染绘：分层苯胺染料浴、星形菱形麦穗与太阳细蜡线、漆面饱和色块。

description_en: Japanese woodblock high embossing: uninked washi relief, raked-light paper topography, raised line without full-color nishiki-e printing.
description_zh: 日本木版高摺：无墨和纸浮凸、侧光纸面起伏、以凸线造型而非锦绘套色。

description_en: Dalecarlian folk wall painting: flat distemper on timber, naive shallow space, strong contour, bright reds blues greens, narrative mural figure.
description_zh: 达拉纳民间墙绘：木板胶彩平涂、浅空间、强轮廓、红蓝绿色块、叙事壁画人物。

description_en: Northwest Coast Chilkat weaving: mountain-goat wool and cedar warp, yellow black white blue-green weft, formline ovoids and U-forms, hanging fringe.
description_zh: 西北海岸奇尔卡特织：山羊毛与雪松经线、黄黑白蓝绿纬线、形态线卵形与U形、下垂经穗。

description_en: South Indian rice-flour floor drawing: pulli dots, looping kambi lines, powder grain on dark earth.
description_zh: 南印度米粉地绘：点阵、连续曲线、深色地面上的粉线质感。

description_en: Javanese painted narrative scroll: flat theatrical figures, mineral reds and gold, stacked ornamental space.
description_zh: 爪哇画卷皮影：平面戏妆人物、矿物红与金、层叠装饰空间。

description_en: Balinese Batuan school: horror vacui ink, muted earth wash, packed foliage and temple ornament.
description_zh: 巴厘巴图安派：满密墨线、灰褐薄染、庙宇与密叶填满画面。

description_en: Igbo ideographic graphic art: chalk-white and ochre glyphs on indigo-black, nested ritual signs.
description_zh: 伊博表意图形：靛黑底上白垩与赭石符号、嵌套仪式纹样。

description_en: Osaka–Kyoto ukiyo-e woodblock: soft Kamigata palette, keyblock line, bokashi washes on cream washi.
description_zh: 大阪京都浮世绘：柔和上方色、主版墨线、乳色和纸上的晕染渐变。

description_en: Māori rafter painting: koru and kape spirals in flat red, black, and white on timber-red ground, bilateral rhythm, no modeling.
description_zh: 毛利椽绘：红黑白平面涡卷考鲁纹、木红底、左右节奏，无体积光影。

description_en: Central Tibetan Menri school: mineral malachite and azurite, gold outline, enamel-smooth flesh, curling clouds, brocade borders.
description_zh: 卫藏门日画派：石绿石青矿彩、金线勾勒、珐琅般肤色、卷云与织锦边饰。

description_en: Persian qalamkar woodblock cotton: madder, indigo, mustard and black stamps, boteh repeats, slight misregistration, visible weave.
description_zh: 波斯盖拉姆卡尔木模印棉：茜红靛蓝芥黄墨黑、佩斯利重复、轻微错位、布纹可见。

description_en: Guerrero Olinalá lacquer: rayado and punteado layers of earth-red and black carved through, gold-leaf dots, glossy lacquer sheen.
description_zh: 格雷罗奥利纳拉漆：刮刻与点绘层叠土红与黑漆、金箔点、亮漆光泽。

description_en: Swedish bonadsmålning: distemper on linen, flat naive figures in registers, folk reds and blues, dark outline, matte chalky paint.
description_zh: 瑞典博纳德墙绘：亚麻胶粉、分层平面人物、民间红蓝、深色勾线、哑光粉质。

description_en: Heian yamato-e facial idiom: slit pulled-line eyes, hooked-nose mark, tiny mouth, powdered skin, layered kasane robes, gold cloud bands, mineral pigments, no Western perspective.
description_zh: 平安大和绘面相程式：引目细眼、钩鼻、小口、傅粉肌、层叠配色十二单、金银霞带、矿物颜料、无西式透视。

description_en: Korean folk letter painting: giant Hanja whose strokes are built from birds, flowers, books and scholar objects; minhwa outline; mineral reds, blues and greens on mulberry paper.
description_zh: 朝鲜民画文字图：以花鸟、书册、文房将汉字笔画填满；民画勾线；矿物红蓝绿；皮纸底。

description_en: Levantine painted wood: relief gesso pastiglia on panels, floral arabesques, cypress and vase cartouches, gilding, matte tempera, Damascene qa’a interior ornament.
description_zh: 黎凡特阿贾米木彩：石膏堆塑、花卉卷草、柏树与瓶花开光、贴金、哑光蛋胶、大马士革厅堂饰板。

description_en: Balinese Keliki miniature: dense Kamasan-derived fine ink and earth pigment, wayang-derived figures, patterned kamben, tree-of-life fillers, no empty ground.
description_zh: 巴厘克利基细密：卡马桑派生密线、大地色矿物颜料、瓦扬身形、锦裙纹、生命树填空、满幅无留白。

description_en: Iberian Mudéjar ornament: sebka nets, multifoil arches, yesería stucco, polychrome artesonado ceilings, eight-point stars, glazed tile dados in ivory, terracotta, gold and cobalt.
description_zh: 伊比利亚穆德哈尔装饰：塞布卡网纹、多叶拱、石膏雕饰、彩绘木顶、八角星、釉砖墙裙，牙白、陶红、金与钴蓝。

description_en: Scraped vellum strata: ghost under-writing, iron-gall browns, ruling lines, parchment tooth, and overlapping script pentimenti as the pictorial surface.
description_zh: 刮去重写的羊皮纸层：底稿残字、五倍子铁墨棕褐、栏线、羊皮齿面与叠层字迹作为画面肌理。

description_en: Hand-brushed silver-gelatin emulsion: pooling highlights, irregular coating, darkroom grain, and paper fiber showing through thin scumbles.
description_zh: 手刷银盐液体乳剂：积液高光、厚薄不均的涂布、暗房银粒，薄处透出纸纤维。

description_en: 1930s British Vivex three-color pigment print: stacked velvety CMY films, slight misregister fringing, matte dye relief, wine-red and bottle-green palette.
description_zh: 1930年代英国维韦克斯三色颜料印：层叠丝绒CMY色膜、轻微套色错位、哑光颜料起伏，酒红与瓶绿调。

description_en: Japanese pictorial kasuri: indigo weft-resist, rust and ivory supplements, stepped ikat edges, and a visible warp-weft grid woven as the image.
description_zh: 日本绘絣：靛蓝纬絣、锈色与牙白补色、阶梯状絣边，经纬网格织成画面。

description_en: Jian-ware hare's-fur iron glaze as pictorial surface: radiating silvery-brown striations, viscous tenmoku flow, metallic sparkle, deep black-brown pools.
description_zh: 建窑兔毫铁釉作画面：放射银褐毫纹、黏稠天目流釉、金属闪光与深褐黑釉潭。

description_en: Heian tsukuri-e: opaque mineral fills over underdrawing, then contours re-inked in sumi; malachite, azurite, cinnabar, gofun, and gold-leaf clouds in flattened Yamato-e space.
description_zh: 平安作绘：矿物色填满底稿后再以墨线钩勒轮廓；石绿、石青、朱砂、胡粉与金云，平面大和绘空间。

description_en: Māori tāniko weft-twining as the image: geometric triangles, diamonds and chevrons in black, red and undyed flax-white, with every form built from visible twined fiber.
description_zh: 毛利塔尼科纬编作画面：黑、红与本色亚麻白的三角、菱形与人字纹，形体全由可见编织结构构成。

description_en: Porcupine quillwork embroidery: flattened dyed quills stitched in zigzags and lanes on smoked hide; ivory, scarlet, turquoise and black over visible sinew and grain.
description_zh: 豪猪羽管刺绣：压扁染色羽管以锯齿与条带缝于烟熏皮面；牙白、朱红、松石与黑，筋线与皮纹可见。

description_en: Japanese kijiro-nuri: crystal-clear amber-brown urushi over wood grain, wet gloss, no gold powder; honey-to-tea translucency with the wood figure as the image.
description_zh: 日本木地吕涂：琥珀褐透明漆覆于木纹、湿亮无金粉；蜜色至茶褐半透明，木理即画面。

description_en: Kumaoni Aipan: white rice-paste (biswar) motifs on geru red-ochre ground; concentric dots, lotuses and ritual borders with no modeling or Western perspective.
description_zh: 库马翁阿伊潘：白米浆纹绘于赭红底；同心点、莲花与仪礼边饰，无明暗、无西式透视。

description_en: Cubist papier collé: glued newsprint, faux-bois wallpaper and flat paper facets with charcoal contours; overlapping torn edges replace modeling and perspective.
description_zh: 立体主义贴纸拼贴：新闻纸、仿木纹墙纸与色纸块面胶合，木炭轮廓勾勒；撕裂叠边取代明暗与透视。

description_en: Venetian smalti: hand-cut opaque glass tesserae set with tilted andamento; gold-leaf sandwich cubes and uneven grout catch raking light.
description_zh: 威尼斯熔块马赛克：手切不透明玻璃贴片沿形体走向倾斜镶嵌；夹金箔方块与不平填缝在侧光下闪烁。

description_en: Sanganer hand-block print: fine floral bootis and jaal on off-white cotton, layered wooden-block registration in indigo and madder with slight misalignment.
description_zh: 桑加内尔木版印：细密花卉小团花与网纹印于本白棉布；靛蓝与茜红多层套色，带轻微错版。

description_en: Hydraulic cement tile: inlaid pigmented-cement motifs in a grouted grid of 20 cm squares, matte mineral color with no glaze, pressed floral-geometric medallions.
description_zh: 液压水泥花砖：20厘米方砖网格中嵌色水泥纹样，无釉矿物哑光，压印几何花卉团心。

description_en: Trace monotype (back-drawing): paper over an inked plate, stylus pressure transfers fuzzy lines and grainy darks onto a pale plate-tone ground, one unique impression.
description_zh: 背描单版：纸覆于着墨版上从背面描压，糊线与颗粒暗部转印到浅版调底，一版一印。

description_en: Bhil tribal painting: every form packed with ritual multi-color dots on warm ochre, iconic outlines, no modeled shading.
description_zh: 比尔部落画：暖赭底上以多色仪典圆点填满形体，图式轮廓，无体积明暗。

description_en: Tibetan colored-sand mandala: poured mineral grains, concentric palaces, cloud-and-flame borders, granular sparkle.
description_zh: 藏传彩砂坛城：矿物细砂倾绘，同心宫殿与云焰边饰，颗粒闪光。

description_en: Egyptian sunken relief: figures recessed into sandstone, incised contours, raking light, traces of mineral polychromy.
description_zh: 埃及阴刻浮雕：形象凹入砂岩石面，轮廓阴刻，侧光起棱，残留矿物彩。

description_en: Art Informel / tachiste matter painting: grit-laden oil, tar and plaster, violent knife sweeps on stained canvas.
description_zh: 不定形艺术／塔希主义物质绘画：掺砂沥青油彩，刮刀猛扫于渍染画布。

description_en: Jinshan peasant painting: flat folk pigments, horror vacui flowers fish and village motifs, no chiaroscuro.
description_zh: 金山农民画：平面民间重彩，繁花游鱼村落铺满画面，无体积明暗。

description_en: Stormont marbling: combed ink veins interrupted by turpentine gall spots that burst into speckled islands on the size bath.
description_zh: 斯托蒙特水拓：梳纹墨脉被松节油斑点打断，爆成细密斑岛。

description_en: Spazialismo: taut picture-plane slashed and punctured so cosmic void shows through the cuts rather than painted illusion.
description_zh: 空间主义：绷紧画面被划开穿孔，宇宙空隙从切口透出，而非画出来的纵深。

description_en: Paper tole: die-cut printed layers stacked with spacers, scored curled edges and drop shadows as dimensional decoupage.
description_zh: 立体剪贴：多层模切纸片垫高叠合，卷边与投影做成浮雕式剪贴。

description_en: Diamond dust: flat color fields encrusted with crushed-glass grit that scintillates under raking light.
description_zh: 钻石尘：平面色块覆以碎玻璃微粒，侧光下闪烁结晶颗粒。

description_en: Bagru block print: iron-black outlines, dabu resist and earth dyes on cotton, rustic buti repeats with slight misregistration.
description_zh: 巴格鲁木版印：铁黑勾线、泥防染与土色染料印于棉布，粗放碎花略有错位。

description_en: Terrazzo: polished cement matrix packed with marble, glass and shell chips, ground flush so grout seams and aggregate facets form the picture.
description_zh: 水磨石：水泥基质嵌大理石、玻璃与贝壳碎粒，磨平抛光，细接缝与骨料切面构成画面。

description_en: Duotone: two-ink photomechanical print, warm black plus one spot color, hard midtone split and paper-tooth squash, no process color.
description_zh: 双色调：双墨照相制版，暖黑加一专色，中间调硬切与纸纹压墨，无四色印刷。

description_en: Assemblage: found wood, tin, cloth and wire stacked on a shallow plane with real cast shadows between pieces, not painted collage.
description_zh: 集合艺术：废木、铁皮、织物与铁丝叠成浅浮雕，件间真实投影，非平面拼贴绘画。

description_en: Eggshell mosaic: crushed eggshell tesserae set in dark lacquer, white-brown craquelure and tiny grout gaps as ran-kaku inlay.
description_zh: 蛋壳镶嵌：碎蛋壳嵌于深漆，白褐裂纹与细缝做成卵壳嵌（らんかく）画面。

description_en: Couching: laid gold and silk cords held by paired perpendicular stitches, raised metal thread on dark silk, not printed foil.
description_zh: 盘金绣：金银线平铺再以成对垂直针钉住，深色丝绸上凸起金线，非烫金箔。

description_en: Andalusian yesería: deep-cut white gypsum stucco, incised arabesques, raking lime-plaster relief.
description_zh: 安达卢西亚灰泥透雕：石膏浮雕深刻、几何缠枝、侧光照出石灰阴影。

description_en: Tang–Song qinglü shanshui: opaque malachite and azurite mineral pigments with gold contour lines.
description_zh: 唐宋史青绿山水：石青石绿重彩、金线勾勒、矿物颜料体量。

description_en: Sichuan Mianzhu New Year woodblock: thick black outlines, flat mineral overprint, paper grain.
description_zh: 四川绵竹年画：浓墨木版线、矿物色套印、纸纹与错版趣味。

description_en: Italian metaphysical painting: long raking shadows, empty arcades, enameled oil, steep piazza space.
description_zh: 意大利形而上绘画：长斜影、空廊柱、瓷釉油彩、陡峭广场透视。

description_en: Chinese bei ta ink squeeze: dense black field, white raised-stroke figure as if rubbed from carved stone.
description_zh: 碑拓技法：满墨底、凸起白线如从石刻椎拓，纸纤维与积墨。

description_en: Book marbling ondas españolas: pigments combed into long chevron swells on carrageenan size, stone-spot blooms in the troughs.
description_zh: 书籍水拓西班牙波纹：颜料梳成起伏人字波，槽谷中夹石纹斑点。

description_en: Late-Edo Akita school Western-style oil: brown imprimatura, naive chiaroscuro, linear perspective, Prussian blue and earth pigments.
description_zh: 江户后期秋田兰画：褐色底子、略生涩明暗与透视，普鲁士蓝与土色油画。

description_en: Cook Islands appliqué quilt: layered cut-out cotton florals, blanket stitch, batting puff, radial tivaevae composition.
description_zh: 库克群岛贴花被：多层剪布花卉、毯针缝迹、夹棉微鼓与放射构图。

description_en: San Ildefonso reduced blackware: matte carbon-black motifs on mirror-burnished black slip, value contrast only.
description_zh: 圣伊尔德丰索还原黑陶：哑光炭黑纹饰压在镜面抛光黑化妆土上，仅靠明度对比。

description_en: 1860s Pellet siderotype: Prussian-blue line-and-wash on cream paper, the positive inverse of Herschel cyanotype.
description_zh: 1860年代佩莱铁盐正像：普鲁士蓝线描淡染于乳白纸，与赫歇尔负像蓝晒相反。

description_en: Dramatic 1960s gekiga ink: pooled blacks, G-pen hatch, coarse screentone, cinematic low-angle staging.
description_zh: 1960年代剧画墨法：积墨、G笔排线、粗网纹、电影式低机位。

description_en: Warsaw poster gouache and litho crayon: torn-paper edges, acidic ochre-crimson-slate, condensed painterly metaphor.
description_zh: 华沙海报水粉与石版蜡笔：撕纸边缘、赭红石板酸色、压缩的绘画隐喻。

description_en: Cut gouache-painted paper: scissor-cut silhouettes, unmodulated color fields, overlapping flat collage with no outline.
description_zh: 水粉着色剪纸：剪刀剪影、无调子色块、无轮廓的层叠平面拼贴。

description_en: E-6 chemistry on C-41 stock: cyan-green shadows, magenta-orange highlights, high contrast and chemical grain.
description_zh: E-6药液冲C-41底片：青绿色阴影、品红橙高光、高反差与药膜颗粒。

description_en: German Jugendstil line: whiplash flora, flat gold-sage-burgundy panels, woodcut contour woven into ornament.
description_zh: 德国青年风格线描：鞭梢植物纹、金与灰绿酒红平涂、木刻轮廓织入装饰。

description_en: Japanese Mono-ha: unaltered timber, stone, rope, steel and still water; gravity and raw matter over depiction.
description_zh: 日本物派：未经加工的木材、石、绳、钢板与静水；重力与物质本身先于描绘。

description_en: T'boli abaca warp-ikat: cream, earth-red and black dream-motifs with feathered resist edges and warp striation.
description_zh: 特博利蕉麻经絣：米白、土红与黑的梦纹，防染羽化边与经线肌理。

description_en: Darkroom split tone: gold-amber highlights against teal-cyan shadows on silver-gelatin grain.
description_zh: 暗房分割调色：金琥珀高光对青绿色阴影，银盐颗粒。

description_en: Arita porcelain painting: cobalt underglaze, iron-red aka-e and kinrande gold on milky crazed white glaze.
description_zh: 有田烧彩绘：釉下钴蓝、铁赤赤绘与金襴手，乳白开片釉面。

description_en: Kodachrome 64 reversal: dense dye-cloud reds, unique blues and greens, tight grain and high acutance.
description_zh: 柯达克罗姆64反转片：浓密染料云红色、独特蓝绿、细颗粒与高锐度。

description_en: Republican Shanghai calendar-poster painting: porcelain-smooth commercial gouache-lithograph, candy local color, airbrushed cheeks, decorative flora on cream advertising stock.
description_zh: 民国上海月份牌：瓷感商业水粉石版、清透固有色、气刷腮红，奶油广告纸上的装饰花鸟。

description_en: Late-18th-century physionotrace portrait: machine-traced profile contour, copperplate stipple and roulette interior, laid-paper plate mark and plate tone.
description_zh: 十八世纪末轮廓描影肖像：机械描取侧面轮廓，铜版点刻与滚点塑形，布纹纸版痕与余墨。

description_en: Lettriste hypergraphy: letters and glyphs as pictorial matter, overlapping ink and stencil type assembling the figure rather than spelling slogans.
description_zh: 字母派超文字：字母与符号即颜料，叠印墨迹与镂版活字构成形象，而非书写标语。

description_en: Talbot 1830s photogenic drawing: camera-less salted-paper contact, pale lilac-brown silver stain, lace and botanical silhouettes on foxed deckle paper.
description_zh: 塔尔博特一八三〇年代光成素描：无相机盐纸接触印相，淡紫褐银盐渍，毛边纸上的蕾丝与植物剪影。

description_en: English monumental brass rubbing: heel-ball wax pulled over incised brass under paper, raised-line drapery, wax grain, white ground and gothic canopy linework.
description_zh: 英格兰纪念铜板拓印：蜡饼在纸下铜刻上摩擦，凸线衣褶、蜡粒、白地与哥特华盖线描。

description_en: 18th-century European decorative painting imitating Ottoman court art: palmette arabesques, tulip-carnation tiles, gilded crescents, lacquer-red and turquoise with gold leaf.
description_zh: 十八世纪欧洲仿奥斯曼宫廷的装饰绘画：棕叶卷草、郁金香康乃馨瓷砖、镀金新月、漆红与青绿贴金。

description_en: Taille-douce copperplate: burin-cut swelling lines, lozenge cross-hatch, stippled flesh, plate-tone on cream laid paper, no wash.
description_zh: 铜凹版雕刻：雕刀胀缩线、菱形交叉排线、点刻肤色、奶油色布纹纸上的版调，无水墨渲染。

description_en: Cartographic elevation coloring: stacked altitude bands from sea-green lowlands through ochre to rust and white peaks, contour intervals and hillshade as the paint language.
description_zh: 地图分层设色：海拔色带由海绿低地经赭黄至锈棕与白峰，等高线与晕渲即画法。

description_en: Kustom kulture sword-striper enamel: ultra-fine 1-shot freehand lines, teardrop scrolls, candy-apple and metal-flake lacquer ground.
description_zh: 定制文化剑条饰线：超细单行程手绘珐琅线、泪滴涡卷、糖果苹果与金葱漆底。

description_en: American letterpress wood-type poster: carved wooden type-block texture, Tuscan and condensed gothic silhouettes, overlapping red-black-mustard ink crush on cream stock.
description_zh: 美国木活字海报：雕刻木字块肌理、托斯卡纳与紧缩哥特轮廓、红黑芥末叠印与压印涨墨。

description_en: Three-strip dye-transfer cinema color: imbibition scarlet-emerald-cyan, slight channel misregister, velvety blacks, cream highlight roll-off, optical glow and fine grain.
description_zh: 三带染料转印电影色彩：猩红-翠绿-青的浸染叠印、轻微套色错位、丝绒黑、奶油高光滚降、光学辉光与细颗粒。

description_en: Potassium-silicate mineral mural on lime plaster: earth-oxide pigments locked into porous wall tooth, chalky matte breathable surface, no oil gloss or varnish.
description_zh: 石灰墙钾硅酸盐矿彩：土氧化物颜料渗入多孔墙齿、白垩哑光透气表层，无油光与罩光漆。

description_en: Hairy Who storefront figuration: enamel-bright comic contours, clashing decorative patterns, hot pink-acid green-mustard, slightly grotesque-cute exaggeration.
description_zh: 毛发谁派橱窗具象：珐琅亮色漫画轮廓、冲突装饰纹样、热粉-酸绿-芥末黄，略带怪诞的可爱夸张。

description_en: Fast-drying oil-alkyd: buttery wet-into-wet blends, enamel-like semi-gloss skin, slight ambering in darks, impasto ridges that level smoother than linseed oil.
description_zh: 快干醇酸油画：黄油般湿接湿融合、珐琅半光肤色、暗部微琥珀、比亚麻油更易流平的厚涂脊。

description_en: Amami mud-and-plant ikat silk: iron-mud brown-black ground, rust-indigo kasuri units, hand-tied resist dash blur, dry woven sheen rather than print or embroidery.
description_zh: 奄美泥染植物絣绸：铁泥棕黑底、锈色与靛蓝絣纹、手绑防染虚边、干燥织纹光泽而非印花或刺绣。

description_en: Caravaggio-school tenebrism: a single raking cellar shaft, pitch-black void, theatrical chiaroscuro, umber-and-flesh oil glaze rather than broken impressionist color.
description_zh: 卡拉瓦乔派暗色法：一束地窖斜光、漆黑虚空、戏剧明暗、赭土与肉色油釉而非印象派断彩。

description_en: Abstraction lyrique: stained poured veils, calligraphic gesture, translucent color storms, atmospheric wash collision without hard-edge geometry.
description_zh: 抒情抽象：浸染倾倒色纱、书法式笔势、半透明色风暴、氛围晕染碰撞而无硬边几何。

description_en: 17th–18th c. Ethiopian Gondar mural-icon: frontal hieratic figures, oversized almond eyes, flat local color, patterned textile grounds, gold contours, no Western perspective.
description_zh: 十七至十八世纪埃塞俄比亚贡达尔壁画圣像：正面仪轨人物、放大杏眼、平涂固有色、织物纹地、金线轮廓、无西方透视。

description_en: Isishweshwe indigo discharge print: Prussian-indigo cotton, dense geometric pin-dot and rosette repeats in discharged white, crisp textile drape rather than batik crackle or ikat blur.
description_zh: 伊西什韦什韦靛蓝拔染印花：普鲁士蓝棉布、密几何针点与玫瑰纹拔白、清晰织纹垂感而非蜡染裂纹或絣织虚边。

description_en: Photographic sandwich: a sharp detailed layer fused with a defocused overexposed glow, dreamy luminous bloom and analog slide-halo rather than HDR crunch.
description_zh: 摄影夹层：清晰细节层与失焦过曝辉光叠合，梦幻光晕与幻灯片光晕而非HDR硬对比。

description_en: Tin-glazed earthenware with reduction-fired copper and ruby metallic luster, crazing, arabesque reserves.
description_zh: 锡白釉陶、还原烧铜红金虹彩、开片与卷草留白。

description_en: Matte palladium print: warm split tone, rag-paper fiber, long continuous scale, no hard digital contrast.
description_zh: 哑光钯盐印相、暖调分离、棉纸纤维、绵长连续影调。

description_en: Talbot-Klič photogravure: velvety aquatint grain, deep intaglio ink, cream paper, continuous tone.
description_zh: 塔尔博特-克利奇照相凹版、飞尘绒粒、深凹油墨、连续调。

description_en: Murano vetro a canne: pulled and fused colored glass rods, filigrana twist, fire-polished refraction.
description_zh: 穆拉诺玻璃棒：拉制熔接色棒、细丝扭转、火抛折射。

description_en: Woodblock ita-bokashi: gradation carved into the block as stepped relief, nishiki-e pigments, washi grain.
description_zh: 板晕染：晕层刻入木版的阶梯浮雕、锦绘颜料、和纸肌理。

description_en: Mingei folk-craft painting: muted earth kiln pigments, irregular handmade grain, Yanagi beauty of the ordinary.
description_zh: 民艺：泥土窑色、手工不均肌理、柳宗悦式日常之美。

description_en: Beggarstaff Brothers cut-paper poster: flat silhouettes, two-to-four inks, stencil edges, empty ground.
description_zh: 贝格斯塔夫：剪纸平涂剪影、两至四色油墨、镂空边缘、留白底。

description_en: Cartographic hachure: parallel slope strokes, denser on steep planes, copperplate map engraving on cream paper.
description_zh: 晕滃线：平行坡向短线、陡坡加密、铜版地图雕线、奶油纸。

description_en: Skip-bleach retained-silver process: crushed blacks, metallic highlights, desaturated primaries, heavy grain.
description_zh: 跳漂：留银叠层、死黑、金属高光、去饱和原色、重颗粒。

description_en: Historiated initial: figure inside a decorated capital, burnished gold leaf, egg tempera on vellum.
description_zh: 绘饰首字母：字母内绘人物、打磨金箔、羊皮纸蛋彩。

description_en: Coquille board: pebbled stipple tooth catching crayon, Wolff pencil, and ink on grey illustration board.
description_zh: 贝壳纹画板：灰色颗粒纸面吃住蜡笔、沃尔夫铅笔与墨线。

description_en: Redscale film: camera loaded reversed so the red-sensitive layer sees first; rust-amber world, analog grain.
description_zh: 红鳞：胶卷反向装填，红敏层先曝光，锈琥珀世界与胶片颗粒。

description_en: Tsuikoku: pictorial relief carved into built-up layers of jet-black urushi lacquer, raking-light incisions.
description_zh: 堆黑：多层黑漆堆起再雕刻图像，侧光勾出阴刻轮廓。

description_en: Sangiri: wood-fired unglazed stoneware with fly-ash deposits, scorch marks, and carbon impregnation.
description_zh: 桟切：柴烧裸胎，飞灰落釉、火痕与渗碳形成自然窑变。

description_en: Ordered dither: Bayer threshold-matrix patterning, limited palette, no smooth gradients.
description_zh: 有序抖动：拜耳阈值矩阵排布，有限色阶，无平滑渐变。

description_en: Bencharong: Thai five-color overglaze enamel on porcelain — jewel reds, emerald, yellow, cobalt, and gold on a vitreous white ground.
description_zh: 宾差隆：泰式五彩釉上珐琅瓷，宝石红、翠绿、黄、钴蓝与金线覆于玻璃质白地。

description_en: Shishiai-maki-e: urushi lacquer where raised takamaki-e gold and burnished togidashi merge in one surface.
description_zh: 肉合莳绘：高莳绘凸起金粉与研出莳绘磨平同处一漆面。

description_en: Kindei: powdered gold bound in animal glue, brushed as granular gold wash and line — not foil, not chrome.
description_zh: 金泥：金粉调胶，刷成带颗粒的金渲与金线，非箔亦非镀铬。

description_en: Error diffusion: Floyd–Steinberg serpentine dither, organic wormy speckle, limited palette — not a Bayer ordered matrix.
description_zh: 误差扩散：弗洛伊德-斯坦伯格蛇形抖动，有机蠕点与有限色阶，非拜耳有序矩阵。

description_en: Xerox art: electrostatic toner on paper, generation-loss bloom, high-contrast copy-machine grain and smear.
description_zh: 复印艺术：静电碳粉、多次复印世代损失、高反差复印机颗粒与拖影。

description_en: Cel shading: hard ink outlines, stepped lighting bands, flat color ramps, specular as a hard white shape.
description_zh: 赛璐璐着色：硬边墨线、分阶光照、平涂色阶、高光成块。

description_en: Rotoscope: frame-by-frame traced contours over painterly fill, slight outline jitter, analog grain.
description_zh: 转描：逐帧描摹轮廓、手绘填色、轻微轮廓抖动与胶片颗粒。

description_en: Coulage: surrealist pouring of molten wax or metal, chance drips, pooling, accidental silhouettes.
description_zh: 倾倒法：超现实主义熔蜡/熔金倾倒、偶然滴淌与凝结轮廓。

description_en: Pinscreen: thousands of pins at varying depths, volumetric grayscale relief, side-lit pin-head sparkle.
description_zh: 针幕：深浅不一的针阵、体积灰度浮雕、侧光针头高光。

description_en: Entoptic graphomania: scattered ink dots connected by straight and curved lines into an automatic drawing.
description_zh: 内视书写狂：散布墨点再以直线与曲线相连的自动素描。

description_en: Gypsography: plaster-cast relief print, chalky gypsum grain, shallow embossed ridges, ivory ground.
description_zh: 石膏凸版：石膏铸凸版、白垩质地、浅浮雕棱线与象牙底。

description_en: Anaglyptography: 19th-century relief-line engraving whose swelling parallel hatch reads as embossed metal.
description_zh: 浮凸线刻：十九世纪浮雕线刻，平行线疏密起伏如浮雕金属。

description_en: Albertype: collotype photomechanical print, continuous-tone gelatin grain, warm brown-black ink, no halftone dots.
description_zh: 阿尔伯类型：珂罗版照相制版、连续调明胶颗粒、暖棕黑墨、无网点。

description_en: Electrotint: electrolytic open-bite on copper, irregular aquatint-like grain, velvety blacks and leftover plate tone.
description_zh: 电蚀铜版：电解咬蚀铜版、不规则飞尘状颗粒、丝绒黑与残留版调。

description_en: Petit feu: low-fire overglaze enamel on porcelain, bright on-glaze colors fused over a glossy white glaze.
description_zh: 低温釉上彩：低温釉上珐琅、亮色附着于光泽白釉之上。

description_en: Girih: Islamic geometric strapwork of interlocking polygons and construction lines — decagons, bowties, and stars as tessellated girih tiles.
description_zh: 吉里纹：伊斯兰几何带饰，十边形、蝴蝶结与星形互锁，以吉里拼砖构造线铺陈。

description_en: Bulletism: surrealist ink-shot — ballistic spatters, impact blooms, and radial spray that construct the image from fired droplets.
description_zh: 射墨法：超现实主义射墨，弹道飞溅、冲击绽放与放射喷雾由射出墨滴构成图像。

description_en: Pouncing (spolvero): cartoon transfer through pricked pinholes, charcoal or chalk dust forced into a dotted contour on gesso.
description_zh: 针粉过稿：在刺孔底稿上拍炭粉或粉笔灰，以点状轮廓转印到石膏地。

description_en: Froissage: crumpled-then-flattened paper image whose creases fracture pigment and ink into broken planes and distressed topography.
description_zh: 揉纸法：先揉皱再展平的纸面图像，褶皱将颜料与墨迹撕裂成碎裂平面与纸面起伏。

description_en: Isohelia: equal-density photographic tone separation via stacked lith masks, discrete luminance bands, and graphic darkroom plate steps.
description_zh: 等密度分调：以叠置高反差石版蒙版做等密度分阶，形成离散明度带与暗房制版台阶。

description_en: Jogakbo: Korean wrapping-cloth patchwork of irregular ramie and silk polygons joined with tiny flat-fell seams; pieced geometry as the drawing method.
description_zh: 拼布褓：朝鲜/韩国褓自我拼布，以苎麻与丝绸不规则多边形细密平缝拼接，缝线几何即造型手段。

description_en: Bagh print: Madhya Pradesh hand-block textile, iron-black and alizarin-red vegetable dyes on cream khadi, dense geometric floral jaal and concentric borders.
description_zh: 巴格印花：印度中央邦巴格木版印，铁黑与茜素红植物染料印于本色卡迪棉，密几何花网与层层边饰。

description_en: Tone-line process: graphic-arts photographic conversion sandwiching lith films so continuous tone collapses into razor contour on empty white paper.
description_zh: 色调线工艺：制版暗房以高反差石版片叠合，把连续调压成锋利轮廓线与空白纸地。

description_en: Khyenri: Tibetan painting school with Pala-Indian influence, mineral pigments, gold outline, and softer naturalistic facial shading distinct from Menri and Karma Gadri.
description_zh: 钦热画派：藏画一派，受帕拉印度影响，矿物颜料与金线，面部渲染较门日派、噶玛嘎知更柔和写实。

description_en: Nonpareil marbling: European bookbinding paper; inks on size drawn with a comb into tight parallel wavy lines, distinct from Spanish wave and Stormont.
description_zh: 无双梳纹水拓：欧洲装帧大理石纹，色墨浮于胶液后以梳拉出紧密平行波纹，有别于西班牙波纹与斯托蒙特。

description_en: Hatip Ebru: Ottoman floral marbling; stylus-shaped concentric rosettes of tulip and carnation dropped on size, over a combed ground.
description_zh: 哈提普水拓：奥斯曼花卉水拓，以色针在胶液上点出郁金香与康乃馨式同心花团，衬以梳纹底。

description_en: Tamamushi-nuri: Japanese lacquer whose layered urushi shifts green-gold-violet like jewel beetle wings on a glossy black ground.
description_zh: 玉虫涂：日本漆艺，多层漆膜呈绿金紫干涉光，如玉虫翅鞘，衬深黑高光底。

description_en: Chromolithography: 19th-century multi-stone color lithography; overlapping transparent inks, crayon grain, slight plate misregister on cream stock.
description_zh: 彩色石版：十九世纪多石套色彩印，透明油墨叠层、粉笔颗粒与轻微套版偏移，乳色纸底。

description_en: Polaroid transfer: wet instant-film emulsion peeled onto paper; wrinkled skin, torn edges, dye shift, and paper tooth showing through.
description_zh: 宝丽来转印：即影胶膜湿揭转印到纸上，起皱薄膜、撕边、染料偏移与纸纹透出。

description_en: Newari Paubha: Nepalese mineral-pigment painting on sized cloth; lampblack outline, gold leaf, flat cinnabar-malachite-lapis fields, shallow space.
description_zh: 尼瓦尔帕乌巴：尼泊尔矿物颜料布面画，墨线勾勒、金箔与朱砂孔雀石青金石平涂，浅空间。

description_en: Relief etching: acid-resist painted on copper so the design stands in relief; warm lamp-black ink, bitten edges, light plate tone on cream paper.
description_zh: 凸蚀版画：铜版涂抗蚀绘稿使图形凸起着墨，暖黑墨、咬蚀毛边与浅版调印在米色纸上。

description_en: Gelatin dry plate: glass-plate silver photograph with high acutance, highlight halation, long tonal scale, and slight emulsion specks.
description_zh: 明胶干版：玻璃干版银盐影像，锐利解像、高光晕光、长灰阶与轻微乳剂瑕点。

description_en: Bokusho: postwar abstract ink action; explosive sumi splashes, flying white, wet blooms, and calligraphic black gestures on raw paper.
description_zh: 墨象：战后抽象水墨行动，爆墨飞白、湿渗与书法性黑笔势落在生纸上。

description_en: Sepia toning: sulfur-converted gelatin silver print with chocolate shadows, honey midtones, cream highlights, and continuous-tone grain.
description_zh: 硫调棕印：硫调明胶银盐照片，巧克力暗部、蜜色中间调、奶油高光与连续调颗粒。

description_en: Ma-Xia School: Southern Song one-corner composition, axe-cut cun rock, spare pine, and a large mist void in ink and light color on silk.
description_zh: 马夏画派：南宋边角构图、斧劈皴石、疏松与大片留白烟岚，水墨淡彩绢本。

description_en: 1890s Photoglob photolithograph: translucent litho color inks over a photographic base, postcard grain.
description_zh: 十九世纪末照相石印彩墨：半透明套色叠在照片结构上，明信片颗粒。

description_en: Fifteenth-century Teigdruck: viscous paste pigment stamped in relief on rag paper.
description_zh: 十五世纪浆糊凸印：黏稠色浆压印于布纹纸，微微隆起。

description_en: Scholar-amateur ink on xuan: dry brush, spare space, seals, understated literati manner.
description_zh: 文人墨戏：宣纸干笔、留白、印章，克制的士人笔意。

description_en: Japanese Tang-style painting: mineral color, ink outline, Chinese-derived pictorial structure.
description_zh: 日本唐绘：矿物颜料、墨线勾勒、唐风空间结构。

description_en: Momoyama Hasegawa screen manner: mist ink pines, wet wash, gold-leaf ground.
description_zh: 桃山长谷川派屏风：雾中松树、湿墨晕化、金箔地。

description_en: Under-camera oil on glass: wet-into-wet smears, finger blends, translucent glossy layers.
description_zh: 玻璃板油绘动画：湿叠湿涂抹、指推融合、半透明油层反光。

description_en: 1920s–30s rubber-hose animation: noodle limbs, pie-cut eyes, ink-and-paint on cel, film grain.
description_zh: 二十年代橡皮管动画：软管四肢、扇形高光眼、赛璐珞描线上色、胶片颗粒。

description_en: Ukiyo-e sesame printing: baren-broken ink as fine seed speckles on washi, especially in dark fields.
description_zh: 浮世绘芝麻摺：马连擦出细芝麻点，深色色块呈颗粒，和纸底。

description_en: Nara picture-book illumination: opaque mineral color, gold cloud bands, flat stacking on foxed paper.
description_zh: 奈良绘本：矿物不透明色、金云霞、平面叠景、微微旧纸。

description_en: Bengali alpona floor painting: white rice-paste lines and dots on terracotta ground, lotus lattices.
description_zh: 孟加拉阿尔帕纳地画：白米糊线条与点饰、陶土地、莲花几何。

description_en: Biro drawing: blue-black ballpoint hatching, ink pooling and skip, paper-tooth grooves.
description_zh: 圆珠笔绘：蓝黑圆珠笔排线、墨水积点与跳线、纸齿凹痕。

description_en: Dirty-pour acrylic: silicone cells, lacing, high-flow pigment rivers, wet gloss.
description_zh: 流体丙烯倾倒：硅油晶胞、蕾丝纹、高流颜料河、湿亮膜。

description_en: Watercolor wet-into-wet: pigment blooms in soaked paper, backruns, fused cauliflower edges.
description_zh: 水彩湿叠湿：湿纸渗色、回流斑、融合菜花边。

description_en: 1950s UPA limited-animation graphics: flat color fields, sparse line, mid-century poster shapes.
description_zh: 1950年代UPA有限动画：平涂色块、疏线、世纪中叶海报形。

description_en: Mixteca-Puebla codex painting: flat mineral color, black outline, composite view, amate ground.
description_zh: 米斯特克-普埃布拉手抄绘画：矿物平涂、墨线、复合视角、树皮纸地。

description_en: Ukiyo-e blown-pigment bokashi: flicked or piped color blooms, mottled mist, washi tooth, no hard outline.
description_zh: 浮世绘吹晕摺：吹洒或弹拨颜料形成雾斑、晕色、和纸齿痕，避免硬轮廓。

description_en: Intaglio roulette work: spiked-wheel dotted tracks, velvety plate tone, dashed midtones on laid paper.
description_zh: 凹版滚轮雕：刺轮点线轨迹、润泽版调、铺纸上的虚线中间调。

description_en: Early dotted-print metalcut: punched white dots in a dark inked ground, stamped ornamental punch-work.
description_zh: 早期点刻金属切版：深色墨地上的冲压白点与装饰性点阵。

description_en: Slip-trailing as picture: raised piped clay lines, loops and dots of cream slip on terracotta or buff ground.
description_zh: 沥线化妆土作画：凸起泥浆线、圈点，乳白化妆土覆于陶土或浅赭底。

description_en: Woodblock itamezuri: plank grain printed onto washi, baren swirls, sumi and mineral color sitting in the grain.
description_zh: 木版板目摺：板材木纹直接转印于和纸，马连旋痕，墨与矿物色沉入纹理。

description_en: Ukiyo-e one-line bokashi: a straight wiped sky band fading from solid indigo into paper.
description_zh: 浮世绘一文字ぼかし：直线拭染的天空色带，由实靛蓝晕入纸白。

description_en: Planographic print from a grained aluminum plate: cool metal grain, greasy crayon and tusche.
description_zh: 铝版平版：冷调金属砂目、油性蜡笔与油墨水。
